abel-police.name: Abel Police
abel-police.description: Abel takes police body camera footage and turns it into completed police reports. Currently American patrol officers spend one third of their shift writing reports - turning that to zero would increase the effective police force by 50%, radically changing US cities.

abhi.name: Abhi
abhi.one_liner: Abhi is Pakistan's 1st financial wellness platform focusing on…
abhi.description: An early wage access platform allowing salaried employees to draw down a percentage of their accrued salary before the next payroll cycle. Helping employees to avoid late payment fee on bills, access emergency cash and substitute expensive debt. We work on a B2B2C model allowing companies to extend the product as a benefits program to their employee base.

accountable.name: Accountable
accountable.one_liner: Smarter Spending for Vacation Property Managers
accountable.description:
Accountable is AI-powered accounting automation for vacation rental property managers. These companies spend money on behalf of hundreds or thousands of property owners on cleaning, maintenance, supplies and repairs. Every dollar has to be paid, tracked, and charged back to the right owner, which most teams still do by hand across disconnected systems.

Accountable handles payments, cards, approvals and expense tracking in one place, and syncs everything to the tools property managers already use: their property management software, field operations tools and accounting system. The result is fewer people doing data entry, accurate owner statements, and books that close 90% faster.

Serving tens of thousands of properties.
accountable.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

acely.name: Acely
acely.one_liner: Every student's AI coach for college readiness
acely.description:
Acely is the leading AI tutor for the digital SAT and ACT, helping students get into their dream college. Our mission is to democratize opportunity for high school families through AI-native tools that empower students to learn smarter and gain confidence.

Backed by Forerunner Ventures, we've grown to $10M ARR with a lean, 10-person team, proof that small, mission-driven teams can deliver outsized impact. Our product has traction, our users are engaged, and we're now at an inflection point: ready to scale with speed, craft, and AI-native excellence.

Acely was launched out of beta in January 2024 as a spinout product from Juni (YC W18).

adravision.name: Adravision
adravision.one_liner: Automation for dental clinics and insurance companies.
adravision.description:
We build automation solutions powered by AI to improve the efficiency of diagnostics, documentation, and patient education for dental clinics. Our technology is also used by dental insurance companies to process large volumes of claims by analyzing unstructured data like X-rays, narratives, and documents.

We're a dentist and clinic owner, a computer vision expert, and a bioscientist.

https://www.adra.ai/

adventris-pharmaceuticals.name: Adventris Pharmaceuticals
adventris-pharmaceuticals.description:
Adventris makes cancer vaccines. Our platform solves the problem of targeting poorly immunogenic oncogenes. Our first "off-the-shelf" vaccine targets KRAS, the most common cancer oncogene. In the long run, we envision a world where every adult receives our pan-cancer vaccines annually – preventing the majority of cancer deaths.

If you are interested in learning more about our approach to treat and prevent cancer, please reach out to us at contact@adventris.com

airthium.name: Airthium
airthium.one_liner: Decarbonized heat and power cheaper than fossil fuels
airthium.description:
We build engines that have the potential to slash 33% or worldwide CO2 emissions - cost-effectively.

First, we help food and mining companies cut both their heat costs *and* CO2 emissions by replacing gas-fired steam boilers with our proprietary high temperature heat pumps. Our heat pumps make up to 3x more heat with the same amount of electricity, even at up to 1000°F.

Once the heat pump market is mature, we will address the seasonal energy storage market. Our storage units are based on the exact same proprietary engine we use for our heat pumps. They work with solar and wind, and replace lithium-ion batteries, fossil-fired power plants, CO2 capture and storage, and fuel procurement, with a cheaper, sustainable and more reliable alternative, which can be sited anywhere.

The first opportunity is a high-margin market worth 3% of worldwide CO2. The second is a much bigger market worth 30% of worldwide CO2. By the time all cars become electric, it will be even more.

Our key is we are building the first Stirling engine to reach 86% of the Carnot efficiency, compared to 64% for the state of the art. We do all that while significantly decreasing costs, and increasing reliability.

Please see Airthium's website for more information.

algouniversity.name: AlgoUniversity
algouniversity.one_liner: Building Job driven Virtual Tech University for India 🇮🇳
algouniversity.description:
We are building live teaching infrastructure that enables handful of top educators (from Google, Facebook, etc) to coach a large number of students.
We train college students in a year-long live cohorts and they pay us a portion of their salary as fees once they get a tech job (Income Sharing Agreement)

alguna.name: Alguna
alguna.one_liner: AI-Native CPQ & Billing for Modern Pricing Models
alguna.description:
We are Alguna, building a modern platform that helps B2B companies price deals, send quotes, bill customers, and collect payments - all in one place.

Our mission is to create the most efficient revenue engine for B2B SaaS.

Today, many companies run these processes with spreadsheets and a patchwork of separate tools. That leads to slow approvals, manual work, mistakes, and missed revenue—especially as pricing gets more complex.

Alguna replaces that mess by connecting the entire flow from **quote to cash**: what sales sells becomes what finance bills, automatically. We help teams automate invoicing, handle usage-based or custom pricing, and reduce back-and-forth between sales, finance, and engineering.

The result: growth-stage startups and enterprises can close deals faster, bill accurately, and scale revenue operations without adding headcount or building internal systems.

alice-tech.name: Alice.tech
alice-tech.description:
Alice turns generic course materials into personalized learning and exam prep using AI. We’re Duolingo  for exams, and more than 10k college students have already used Alice. 

Kim, the CEO, is a domain expert in education with more than 10+ years of university teaching experience. He is also technical by background.

MRR is $20k, growing +10% week-over-week the last 8 weeks

Alice's core market opportunity is +$10b, with the global education market being almost $10trillion. As AI starts to disrupt education, Alice will use in-built network effects and virality in its product to create a global winner. 

Go Alice. Thank you!

alt-tex.name: ALT TEX
alt-tex.one_liner: Biodegradable and carbon neutral textiles, engineered from food waste.
alt-tex.description:
ALT TEX is a Toronto-based biomaterials startup that has developed the world’s first biodegradable and carbon neutral fabric, engineered from the world’s largest landfill contributor - food waste. Polyester alone makes up 60% of the $2.5 trillion fashion industry and is the biggest blocker preventing brands from meeting sustainability mandates. The patent-pending ALT TEX fermentation technology creates a polyester alternative that works with the existing infrastructure to supply a sustainable, high performance and cost competitive polyester replacement to fashion brands, at scale. 

The product solves key problems for fashion brands, consumers, and the environment:

(1) Fashion brands: ALT TEX sells fabric to fashion brands, allowing them to differentiate via sustainable options (sustainable fashion growing 11% CAGR) and hit sustainability targets, without sacrificing performance or changing their current supply chain.

(2) Consumer: The ALT TEX fabric is projected to be half the price vs. other specialized sustainable alternatives (due to low-cost input and scalability), meaning greater accessibility.

(3) Environment: A single shirt produced with ALT TEX fabric can divert 1 kg of food waste from landfills, 9 kg of carbon emissions from the air, and 4 g of micro-plastics from our waterways.

Co-founders Myra and Avneet have worked together managing teams and projects for six years, with backgrounds in serial entrepreneurship, corporate sales at Fortune 500 companies, textile manufacturing and biochemistry. To date, ALT TEX has created their first fabric prototype that’s 70% stronger than cotton, secured $1M in LOIs and raised $2.3M.

andi.name: Andi
andi.one_liner: AI Search for the Next Generation
andi.description:
Instead of just links, Andi AI gives you answers - like chatting with a smart friend. 

Andi is a new type of search engine that uses generative AI and language models combined with live data to generate factually correct answers to questions, and to explain and summarize information combined from the best sources. 

Andi works as a search chatbot that's ad-free and privacy-focused. Ask Andi to...

✅  Answer questions
🧠  Find, summarize and explain information
🔍  Navigate and search the web

Search is broken because of SEO spam, ads, and surveillance capitalism. Andi cuts through the clutter to get you straight to the knowledge you need. It presents results visually in a way that's easy to understand with a simple chat interface, and protects you from ad tech and distraction.

You can try the search app at https://andisearch.com

anfin.name: Anfin
anfin.one_liner: A multi-asset trading platform dedicated to retail investors
anfin.description:
Anfin is a modern trading platform that aims to democratize access to financial services and wealth management for Vietnam’s retail investors.

Our mission is to help the underserved retail investor navigate the complexities of investments in Vietnam, from stock market to the underutilized commodity trading.

We are backed by international renowned investors such as YC, Goodwater Capital, Global Founders Capital, and many more.

answerthis.name: AnswerThis
answerthis.one_liner: End-to-end workspace to accelerate scientific discovery
answerthis.description:
AnswerThis is a scientific discovery platform used by over 200,000 researchers that reduces weeks of manual research work to hours. 

Instead of manually searching, reading, and organizing dozens of papers, researchers use AnswerThis to find the most relevant work, see how ideas are connected, and get comprehensive answers to complex scientific questions with line by line answers. 

This allows them to map research gaps, analyze trends, and draft literature reviews far faster, all while building a searchable library of their own research materials.

aon3d.name: AON3D
aon3d.description:
AON3D is a rapidly growing startup on a mission to put industrial 3D printing capabilities into the hands of those who need it most. Our technology has made it 10 times cheaper than before to 3D print with advanced thermoplastics, and we continue to push the boundaries on commercializing new materials for 3D printing. 

Our customers span the globe and are pioneers in the application of 3D printing in their field – from automotive tooling to aircraft interiors, foundry molds to public art installations, prosthetics to guides for radiation and surgical oncology.  

AON3D is a graduate of Y-Combinator and venture-backed by top investors from Silicon Valley.

archangel-health.name: Archangel Health
archangel-health.one_liner: Infra to make AI safe enough to practice medicine
archangel-health.description: Archangel Health builds the infrastructure to post-train and evaluate medical AI: RL environments inside real de-identified EHRs, physician-verified training data, and benchmarks that test clinical reasoning on hard cases. Frontier labs and medical AI companies use it today, and we're now moving toward post-training open-source models for health systems on their own data and their own physicians' judgment

archon.name: Archon
archon.one_liner: We help software companies sell to government.
archon.description:
Archon helps software companies sell to the government by cutting the required federal compliance timeline (called FedRAMP) down from 16 to 6 months and cuts costs by $1M per company. 

Email us at inquiries@archon.inc

askmyclass-now-soundkins.name: AskMyClass, now Soundkins
askmyclass-now-soundkins.one_liner: Audio learning assistant for teachers and students.
askmyclass-now-soundkins.description: AskMyClass, is a learning assistant that helps teachers save time and enhance learning, using smart speakers like Alexa, and help students get back-on-task quickly and build life skills through classroom management, social-emotional learning, and lesson support.

assembly-hoa.name: Assembly HOA
assembly-hoa.description:
Assembly is an AI-native HOA management company on a mission to fix homeowner associations. Traditional HOA management is often reactive, confusing, and inefficient. Assembly takes a different approach by combining professional expertise with intelligent software to make communities run smoothly and decisions easier.

We exist to build trust, create transparency, and ensure well-run communities that protect and enhance property values.

Assembly simplifies day-to-day operations, automates routine tasks, and delivers the right knowledge at the right time. Our platform gives boards and homeowners clarity to make smarter, more confident decisions. 

We manage HOAs in San Francisco Bay Area and Greater Los Angeles.
assembly-hoa.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

astro.name: Astro
astro.one_liner: Power-ready land for AI data centers
astro.description: Astro develops power-ready land for AI data centers. Power is now the bottleneck for new data centers, and Astro’s models find the sites that have it. Founder Alex Fuster traded grid congestion at Citadel across US power markets, predicting where the grid would run out of room.

atomic-industries.name: Atomic Industries
atomic-industries.one_liner: Software orchestrated mass production of plastics
atomic-industries.description: Atomic is a vertically integrated plastics supplier. To offer parts better, cheaper, and faster than anyone on Earth, we became the best mold makers using AI. Our software helps us design and build the best possible mold for each unique geometry, with the goal of moving into production more rapidly than existing supply chains.

audora.name: Audora
audora.one_liner: Audora is Audible 2.0, where stories are immersive & fun to listen to
audora.description:
Audora turns your book or story into an audiobook where every character has their own voice.

The best adaptation of a book is the one in your head. You can see the characters in front of you and hear them talking to each other. We want an audiobook to do those characters justice: a voice that fits each of them, so a conversation actually sounds like a conversation.

Paste a story link or upload a file. Audora works out who’s speaking and gives each character a distinct voice alongside the narrator. You can start listening while the rest of the book is still being made.

Our roots are in fanfiction. We’re building for readers who already know these characters by heart, with a focus on voices that capture their personalities and stay consistent throughout the story.

Try Audora: https://audora.art
Watch the demo: https://youtu.be/R6Pt2O0fD4c

axal.name: Axal
axal.one_liner: We assemble PCBs in under 48 hours for quantities under 10
axal.description:
Axal is a quick-turn PCB assembly shop in San Francisco. Samai and Nand build every board themselves, and both are IPC certified. For quantities under 10, we assemble boards in under 48 hours. Order online in 2 minutes at axal.ai.

Send us your board files and we handle the parts, bare boards, assembly, inspection, and delivery.

beanstalk.name: Beanstalk
beanstalk.one_liner: Great tasting produce, farmed around the corner
beanstalk.description:
Brothers, Michael and Jack, started Beanstalk as a solution to solve a local restaurant’s need for consistent, high-quality salad. In doing so, they created a vertical farming technology capable of growing lettuces, spinach, basil, carrots, lavender, and more.

Beanstalk is at the nexus of industrial robotics, plant science, and the culinary arts. Our technology enables us to develop new products quickly, automate traditionally labor-intensive work, and connect consumers to fresh produce in ways not before seen.

biobot-analytics.name: Biobot Analytics
biobot-analytics.one_liner: Population health analytics powered by wastewater.
biobot-analytics.description:
Our mission is to transform wastewater infrastructure into public health observatories.

Named as one of Fast Company’s most innovative companies in the world in 2021, Biobot Analytics is a wastewater epidemiology company and uses technology developed at MIT to measure biomarkers in sewage to better understand population health in cities. We first launched an opioid product to support government and public health officials in responding to the opioid epidemic, and in 2020 launched a Covid19 product to estimate the scope and trend of the outbreak in communities. We have operated in almost 500 communities across 43 U.S. states, generating Covid19 case estimates for over 13% of the U.S. population.

Battling the opioid epidemic and now the Covid19 pandemic is just the beginning - we’re transforming sewage into a data asset and building a public health database. Eventually, Biobot data will be an early warning system for disease outbreaks, a map of nutrition disparities, and more.

Please visit our website at www.biobot.io

bloom-institute-of-technology.name: Bloom Institute of Technology
bloom-institute-of-technology.one_liner: The online coding school that invests in you.
bloom-institute-of-technology.description:
Bloom Institute of Technology is a full computer science education that's free until you get a high-paying job.

We invest in our students, train them for free, and take a portion of income if they get a job above a certain threshold. If they never make above that threshold or don't get a job in the chosen field, they never pay us a dime.

bloomy.name: Bloomy
bloomy.description: Bloomy is the best way to teach anything in school. We provide schools with an AI-native academic system comprising core and supplemental curriculum, AI teaching, and assessment to help K-12 students learn faster. Backed by the founders of Clever.

blueshoe.name: Blueshoe
blueshoe.one_liner: The AI-Native Consumer + Plaintiff Law Firm
blueshoe.description:
Blueshoe is a full-stack law firm that helps people with everything from everyday legal issues to high-stakes litigation and trial.

People can access legal guidance directly through our web app or the AI interfaces where they are already seeking answers. If representation is needed, Blueshoe attorneys handle many cases all the way to resolution, equipped with cutting-edge data, AI-native tools, and operational support.

bodyport.name: Bodyport
bodyport.description:
Bodyport’s cardiovascular sensing weight scale and predictive algorithms detect early changes in cardiac function to help prevent avoidable hospitalizations. Bodyport is initially targeting heart failure, a chronic condition affecting over 6M Americans and a leading cause of hospitalizations (1M/year) and healthcare spending ($35B/year).

Bodyport’s novel scale measures cardiac output, congestion, heart rate, and other leading indicators of cardiovascular health — all in the same step patients already take to weigh themselves. Companion algorithms and software empower care teams to quickly identify at-risk patients and remotely optimize their therapy to prevent deterioration.

botbuilt.name: BotBuilt
botbuilt.one_liner: We use robots to build houses.
botbuilt.description: BotBuilt is creating flexible robotic systems to solve the housing crisis. Our cutting-edge software and cost-efficient hardware allow us to improve the world by providing beautiful construction, safer job sites, and sustainable building techniques. The $600 billion residential construction industry is facing a massive labor shortage. Our robotic systems leverage the latest in rapid prototyping, artificial intelligence, and computer vision. By taking on some of the hardest technical challenges on earth, BotBuilt is ready to help solve one of society’s biggest problems.

brickanta.name: Brickanta
brickanta.description: Brickanta  – agentic AI for society builders. Hundreds of construction-specific AI agents for project analysis, insights, tenders, procurement, and more. Combine the latest AI technology with your organization's project data, templates, and workflows to identify risks and opportunities early and produce better decision support. Brickanta has raised $8 million from leading AI, construction, and real estate investors behind companies like OpenAI/ChatGPT, Airbnb, Klarna, Spotify, and Plangrid-Autodesk, as well as star investors such as Mario Götze, Anton Osika, and Northzone (see movie and press). The founding team has been building and implementing AI in construction and industry since 2018 at companies such as ABB, Fabege, Husqvarna, IKEA and Konecranes.

brickwise.name: Brickwise
brickwise.one_liner: AI property manager for landlords and estate agents
brickwise.description:
We've built an AI property manager that automates maintenance requests, handling tenant calls and messages 24/7, following up by chasing contractors and resolving issues.

We're based in London, but have over 10 customers throughout the world, from San Francisco to Dubai. We have a reliable sales pipeline, including a >$1m cARR enterprise contract. Since our formation 6 months ago, we have raised over $3M in funding.

Ismail, co-founder & CEO, is an ex-Founder at LiveLink AI, where he raised $3M, growing the platform to editing 150k videos per month. He also built his own prop firm to $500k ARR.

Elias, co-founder & CTO, was an early engineer at a YC backed company, acquired by Google. While a senior engineer at Google for 5 years, he took the product from $50k ARR to >$100m. CS at Bristol, MBA from Imperial.
brickwise.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

cambly.name: Cambly
cambly.one_liner: On-demand access to English tutors over video chat.
cambly.description: The Cambly app gives English learners instant 1-on-1 access to friendly native speakers over video chat 24/7. Students get an affordable and convenient way to practice their English and gain confidence. Tutors get to make money helping people from around the world practice English.

candor.name: Candor
candor.one_liner: We help companies win government funding with AI
candor.description:
Candor helps defense and deeptech companies navigate the government procurement process with AI. We inject agents into the procurement process - agents that not only surface opportunities but actively pursue them - giving anyone the same capabilities as large contractors. 

When we met at Stanford 4 years ago, it was rare for startups to work with the US Government. In the years that we’ve been involved in the burgeoning Defense Tech ecosystem, a lot has changed. Silicon Valley and the US Government are closer than they’ve been in decades.  

As fellows in Stanford’s Center for National Security Innovation, we’ve had the privilege of speaking with dozens of government officials who have come to Silicon Valley looking to fund and scale startups solving their most urgent problems. 

However, we’ve seen firsthand the struggles these startups face in securing gov funding. Marcus, having spoken with dozens of defense startups in his time helping lead the Stanford Defense Tech Club and trying to set up a national security startup accelerator has seen this especially.

That’s why we’re making it easier to find and apply for opportunities, taking the application process from weeks to days.

We’re only going to see more cooperation in the coming years. With that, there will be increasingly more funding going towards companies in defense, energy, biotech, quantum, etc. Candor lets you unlock that funding potential.

carbic.name: Carbic
carbic.one_liner: using ultrasonics + ml to analyze fluid behavior at infrastructure…
carbic.description: We are a sensor company that aims to accurately capture the behavior of high throughput fluid systems. With this information we can help improve operations while reducing spills and theft. This technology could change the way the oil and gas industry, water municipalities, and anyone dealing with high volume fluid, operates. Fleets of our proprietary lightweight hardware send raw ultrasonic data directly to our server via cellular/satellite; we then use a mix of physics equations, signal processing, and anomaly detection to determine the behavior of fluid (volume and speed) in pipes.

catena-biosciences.name: Catena Biosciences
catena-biosciences.one_liner: Using protein coupling to build new therapies
catena-biosciences.description: Catena’s technology lets us attach any two proteins together using an enzyme and the native amino acids tyrosine and cysteine within target proteins. It is a true platform technology because it enables the joining of any two soluble proteins together with minimal engineering and without restrictions due to protein size or complexity. Our work has already been used to modify cancer specific antibodies, CRISPR proteins and even cell surfaces. Our ability to produce modular protein therapeutics in a fraction of the time allows for true library creation across the therapeutics spectrum from oncology, vaccines, inflammatory disease and beyond.

centauri-ai.name: Centauri AI
centauri-ai.one_liner: Helps teams work effectively with AI coding agents.
centauri-ai.description:
We build coSlash, a management layer for AI coding agents. Our platform enables teams to orchestrate parallel Claude Code and Codex sessions, track project progress, team knowledge, and seamlessly transfer context between developers.

https://coslash.io/

chasi.name: Chasi
chasi.one_liner: AI Revenue Engine for the Equipment Industry
chasi.description:
Chasi deploys AI agents that help equipment dealers sell more, respond faster, and maximize fleet utilization - 24/7.

One-third of the cost to build and maintain the physical world goes to equipment, yet fleet utilization across the industry often sits below 60%. Billions in assets sit idle while dealers drown in phone calls, emails, and manual data entry. Missed quotes, slow follow-ups, and disconnected systems mean lost revenue every day.

Chasi plugs into a dealer's existing stack to deploy AI agents that handle sales, rentals, and service requests around the clock. The result: faster response times, higher utilization, and stronger margins, without adding headcount. We automate the busywork so teams can focus on what actually grows the business: customer relationships.

Akash Pavan and Sarman Aulakh have built tractors, race cars, and robots, and previously led AI deployments at Tesla, Boeing, and Cummins, where they saw firsthand how much operational value gets left on the table in equipment-heavy industries. Chasi is live across equipment businesses in the US and Europe.

ciro.name: Ciro
ciro.one_liner: GTM AI that books you 5-8 meetings/week
ciro.description:
Ciro is an AI agent that finds prospects, researches their buying signals, and drafts personalized outreach, all from Slack.

Tell it who you sell to. It finds the right people, figures out why now is the right time to reach out, and writes outreach that sounds like your best rep did 30 minutes of research.

Welcome to the future of selling.

cityfurnish.name: Cityfurnish
cityfurnish.one_liner: Cityfurnish - Commitment-free furniture rentals for a better you!
cityfurnish.description: Cityfurnish is a rental subscription service for furniture and appliances in India. Today, there are 350M people renting unfurnished or semi-furnished apartments in India; Cityfurnish provides an easy, affordable and hassle-free solution. The founding team shares 25+ years of furniture retailing experience and has grown the business to 8,000+ subscribers.

classdojo.name: ClassDojo
classdojo.one_liner: Communication app for K-8 teachers, kids, and families
classdojo.description: ClassDojo's mission is to give every kid an education they love. Our flagship communication app has become the world’s largest network serving kids, reaching over 51 million kids, families and teachers in 180 countries every month, entirely through word of mouth. They use it to share the best moments in a kid's day through pictures, videos, messages, and more. ClassDojo has recognized by Forbes, LinkedIn, Inc and Fast Company, and it is a top 100 Y Combinator company.

clau.name: Clau
clau.one_liner: The real estate superapp for Mexico
clau.description: We are the real estate super app for Mexico combining a marketplace with over 20,000 properties, a crm for brokers, financial services including a mortgage brokerage, renovations and the leading data layer for residential real estate in the country.
clau.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

clearest-health.name: Clearest Health
clearest-health.one_liner: AI revenue recovery for underpaid healthcare claims.
clearest-health.description: Clearest Health is an AI-enabled revenue recovery platform for independent healthcare practices with underpaid out-of-network claims. Through verified IDR benchmarks, claim analysis, and audit-ready dispute support, Clearest helps providers strengthen No Surprises Act appeals and recover revenue that might otherwise be written off.

cleva.name: Cleva
cleva.description:
Cleva breaks down financial borders across the globe by enabling remote workers, individuals, and businesses to hold stablecoin-backed dollars. Specifically, we enable our customers:

1. Receive USD, GBP, EUR payments: Individuals and businesses can receive USD, GBP, and EUR payments into their virtual account.
2. Receive and send stablecoins: They can also receive USDT or USDC, and make global payments via USDT and USDC.
3. Hold funds in USD: They can choose to hold their funds in USD instead of converting to local currency. In high inflation countries, this is extremely desirable as it helps our customers hedge against inflation until they're ready to spend in local currency.
4. Stablecoin-backed cards: We issue cards that are stablecoin-backed and accepted by 150M+ merchants across the globe. Users can fund in stablecoins or fiat, spend anywhere VISA is accepted, and earn cashback in the form of Cleva Points.
5. Savings: We recently launched Cleva Pots, allowing users to save towards their goals and earn yield on their savings.

It's still very early days at Cleva. We've been hyper-focused on our home country Nigeria but we're now expanding to more countries across the globe.

cleverdeck.name: CleverDeck
cleverdeck.one_liner: Collaborate with an artist to commission original artwork you'll live…
cleverdeck.description:
CleverDeck is a customizable-spaced repetition flashcard application for learning foreign language vocabulary.

It contains more than three thousand useful words along with images, native speaker audio, and example sentences.

cocusocial.name: CocuSocial
cocusocial.description: CocuSocial is a marketplace for culinary experience including cooking, baking and tasting classes that are hosted at restaurants and hotels. Our mission is to educate, entertain and connect people through unique culinary experience.

code-four.name: Code Four
code-four.description:
Code Four slashes the administrative burden on law enforcement through AI-driven automation. Officers spend up to a third of their shifts manually transcribing body camera footage, creating inaccuracies, reducing transparency, and cutting into frontline duties. We're here to eliminate these inefficiencies by integrating with body cameras, record management systems, and digital evidence management systems—acting as a software layer for data processing. 

We free the most overworked and underappreciated people in the world: police officers.

conviction.name: Conviction
conviction.one_liner: Agentic Trading Desk in Your Pocket
conviction.description: Trading is now as easy as speaking English. Share your market belief or describe your exact trading strategy. Conviction builds it, backtests it, and deploys an AI agent that monitors the market and executes trades on your behalf.

copia.name: Copia
copia.one_liner: Copia's a for-profit technology company that solves food waste &…
copia.description:
We waste 3X more food than there are hungry mouths to feed. It is not a lack of food that's the issue, but rather an ineffective distribution of that food. Hunger is not a scarcity problem; it's a logistics problem.

For the first time ever, we can effectively donate prepared and highly perishable food to those who need it when we need it most. Copia is a for-profit company that has built technology allowing businesses (e.g., food management companies like Compass Group, corporate cafeterias, universities, hospitals, grocers, caterers, etc.) to easily request pickups of their surplus food, have it matched, and safely delivered to non-profits in need. With Copia, partnering businesses can seamlessly access significant tax savings, dramatically reduce food waste through data and analytics on surplus, and remove CO2 from the atmosphere, all while feeding their community.

We have diverted over 7M pounds of edible food from landfills and provided businesses and nonprofits with over $23M in savings. We will feed over 7M people with incredible food that would have otherwise been wasted!

curvenote.name: Curvenote
curvenote.one_liner: Communication and publishing tools for scientists
curvenote.description: At Curvenote we are building the communication and publishing tools for scientists and engineers. In the future, every scientific report will feature interactive graphs with live data that will make it significantly easier to share and reproduce the work.

dashlabs-ai.name: Dashlabs.ai
dashlabs-ai.one_liner: Software for medical laboratories and clinics
dashlabs-ai.description:
We write software for diagnostic laboratories. We provide the following:

- Cashier system
- Booking system
- Integration with clinical medical instruments (hematology analyzers, chemistry analyzers)
- Integration with imaging equipment (DICOM enabled x-rays, ultrasounds)
- Automatic generation of test results
- Secure sharing of test results with employers and manpower agencies (to help them meet country-specific regulatory requirements)

datafruit.name: Datafruit
datafruit.one_liner: The AI workspace for software implementations
datafruit.description: Datafruit helps enterprise delivery teams understand their customers deeply and deliver more profitably. We build AI agents capture every conversation, structure scope from day one, and use past projects to make every engagement sharper.

dayra.name: Dayra
dayra.one_liner: Data-driven embedded Financial Services for Gig Workers
dayra.description:
Dayra makes it easy for Egyptian businesses offer Loans and virtual bank accounts to their unbanked workers and customers through their App.
For example, one of our customers an Egyptian trucking marketplace uses our API to give truck drivers an early advance on their earnings.

deep-interactions.name: Deep Interactions
deep-interactions.description: Deep Interactions is a collaborative AI builder. We don't leave you with a spaghetti mess of a code. We bring product intelligence and power the context layer that enables your team to build in sync - saving companies tokens, time, and nerves. You give us a problem and we ship a working AI product in the same afternoon.

dimely.name: Dimely
dimely.description:
Dimely helps accounting teams scale their order management & contract review workflows. Today fast-growing tech unicorns like Checkr and Airbyte get more coverage with less manual work by using Dimely’s AI agents to intelligently extract relevant details from core files like Order Forms, MSAs & POs, flag discrepancies, and then sync this information to core finance systems like NetSuite and Stripe.

Dimely leverages what finance and accounting teams love most, spreadsheets, for all its workflows so teams never feel out of place. Teams just replace their existing, siloed Excel spreadsheet with one that's connected and powered by AI. Teams love Dimely for its ease of use and intuitive user experience that saves them hundreds if not thousands of hours a month.

drahim.name: Drahim 💰
drahim.description:
"Drahim" is a slang for money in Arabic (from the ancient Greek Drachma).

The app integrates with banks and provides individuals meaningful spending insights and generates auto savings and investment advice.

For the meaningful insights, the app integrates with banks and automatically categorizes all of your transactions (All of your accounts in one place) and spots spending patterns and behaviors.

Drahim then suggests a saving and investing plan that allows the user to continue living comfortably and to keep spending guilt-free.

Our focus is not necessarily to save you money, rather we grow your money discreetly. Drahim allows you to continue spending but feeling way better doing it.

drama-drama.name: Drama Drama
drama-drama.one_liner: Monetization platform for AI characters and dramas
drama-drama.description:
Drama Drama is building the monetization platform for AI character and drama creators.

Creators are already building AI characters and serialized stories that attract audiences on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other social platforms, but turning that fandom into direct revenue is still difficult.

Drama Drama lets creators monetize their existing characters and series through gated episodes, paid AI character chat across text, voice and video, personalized fan experiences and other direct-to-fan products.

Creators can bring the content and audience they already have. For selected creators who want help producing a series, we also offer optional co-production.

dreamrp.name: DreamRP
dreamrp.one_liner: Tech and platforms for human creators and the entertainment industry
dreamrp.description:
AI entertainment feels like slop because companies bet on technology instead of people.

Companies chase tech because it usually lets them win. But what fans love has never been about the tech.

A fan doesn’t fill their apartment with posters because of the lens a movie was shot on. They do it because of the mind behind the camera.

AI is a power-up. In the wrong hands, more and more of what you see becomes sludge. In the right ones, the good stuff wins.

DreamRP builds for creatives, from indie artists to global stars, because they’ve always been the real reason fans love what they love.

If you get it, message me why.

effigov.name: EffiGov
effigov.one_liner: AI Phone Agents for Local Government
effigov.description:
EffiGov builds AI agents for local government, helping cities, counties, and public agencies automate resident communications across phone, web chat, email, and SMS.

Our AI agents serve more than 2 million residents across 10+ government agencies, answering questions 24/7, handling service requests, looking up permit information, scheduling inspections, and routing complex inquiries to staff. In Sumter County, Florida, EffiGov handles over 12,000 calls per month, with approximately 72% handled without staff intervention.

Unlike traditional IVR systems and generic AI receptionists, EffiGov builds specialized AI agents for government departments, including public works, utilities, permitting, code enforcement, and 311. Our platform integrates with existing phone systems and government software, including Esri ArcGIS, SeeClickFix, and Accela.

Backed by Y Combinator (S25), EffiGov is building the AI infrastructure for local government, starting with the phone.

elip-ai.name: Elip AI
elip-ai.description:
Good matches have reasons.

A title leaves things out. "More responsibility" can mean leading a team, or owning the work without managing anyone. Your resume says what you've done. Elip asks what you want to do next.

For people: add your resume and say what you want and what you'd never take. Each morning Elip reads millions of jobs with that in mind and sends the ones a friend who knows you would send, each with why. When you change, the search changes with you. Free.

For companies: add a role in your own words. Within minutes you get a short list of people who want that kind of work, each with the reason in plain words. You meet once they say yes, and pay 10% of first-year base salary only when you hire. Nobody can pay to appear on a shortlist.

Where Elip is going: a world where nobody has to start from zero with a stranger.

Elip is based in San Francisco.

emi-labs.name: Emi Labs
emi-labs.one_liner: Helping great teams hire better frontline workers, faster.
emi-labs.description:
At Emi Labs (YC '19) we are on a mission to increase frontline workers' access to
professional opportunities by building the infrastructure for Frontline Workers (check our
manifesto here: https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/our-manifesto-building-infrastructure-frontline-workers-emi-labs/). As our first step, we are transforming the high-volume recruiting
process of Frontline Workers to make it as simple, human, and fair as possible for both
Candidates and Recruiters. Our product is a SaaS recruitment platform powered by AI
that helps companies engage with candidates via text to drive faster and more efficient
hiring processes. We are growing fast, well funded, and obsessed with making our mission
a reality.

Some of their customers include Walmart, Burger King, Starbucks, 7-Eleven, Danone, Imperfect Foods, and Heineken.

erad.name: erad
erad.one_liner: Non-dilutive funding and payments in the Middle East
erad.description: erad provides startups in the Middle East with non-dilutive growth capital. Connect your sales, marketing and banking data and receive an offer within 48 hours. Get access to key insights and analysis about your business.

ethos-space-resources.name: Ethos Space Resources
ethos-space-resources.one_liner: We make silicon on the Moon, to power everything in space.
ethos-space-resources.description: Ethos makes silicon on the Moon to power terawatt scale data centers. The Moon's surface is 21% silicon. We melt and electrolyze the lunar surface to make raw materials for solar panels. With solar panels made from the Moon, the constraint that limits data center scaling and everything else in space is gone.

exosat.name: Exosat
exosat.one_liner: Building a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink
exosat.description:
Exosat is building thousands of low-cost communication satellites to provide a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink. By designing our satellites with zero ITAR/EAR-controlled content, we can leverage manufacturers anywhere in the world to produce our satellites at under a tenth of the cost and launch them from other nations to bypass capacity bottlenecks and access equatorial orbits. 

We're starting off by selling connectivity to device OEMs and network operators, but will eventually use the distributed compute across our constellation to run low-latency inference for robots and autonomous vehicles in remote and rural areas anywhere on the planet.

We've already signed hundreds of millions in LOIs to work with operators across Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, booked our first satellite launch next year, and hold an 11,000 satellite filing with the ITU to build the largest comms network outside of the U.S. and China.

f4-industries.name: F4 Industries
f4-industries.one_liner: The GD&T Analysis Platform for Engineering Drawings
f4-industries.description:
GD&T takes years to master. Engineers must encode their design intent into a dense syntax that manufacturers must decode, and not everyone gets it right. 

Put ten engineers in front of the same drawing and you may get ten different interpretations. Which means errors often surface later in interface stack-ups, manufacturing, or in the field - when they’re far more expensive to fix.

That’s why we built F4 - the platform that analyzes GD&T to determine whether your designs are ready for production.

Drop in your drawing and 3D file. F4 analyzes every element of your GD&T to assess whether your design is clear, manufacturable, and production ready. To make the drawing easier to understand, engineers can visualize their datums, reference frames, and tolerance zones directly on the 3D model. F4 also calculates tolerance stack-ups instantly - directly from the drawing. What once took hours of manual work now takes seconds.

When issues are found, F4 flags them and guides engineers toward resolving the problem.

After analyzing your drawing, F4 also automatically generates design and inspection reports - stack-up tables, FAI reports - ready to share with your team.

And it does all of this locally on-device with no AI used for analysis. Producing deterministic results engineers can trust.

filta.name: Filta
filta.description: Filta is the face filter NFT marketplace being built by veterans from Pixar/Oculus/Facebook. We partner with creators to release limited-edition filters for their fans to use on social media. It turns out: the face filters you see everywhere on Snapchat and Instagram are created by independent artists - not by the platforms. These artists ALMOST NEVER get money for their work - which is insane! Filta fixes this by giving these creators a marketplace and the best filter creation tool anywhere. Interested in working on the future of digital fashion, AR/VR, and web3? Hit us up. We're hiring.

finflx.name: FinFlx
finflx.one_liner: Flexible Workplace Savings plans for SMEs in MENA.
finflx.description:
FinFlx makes it easier and more affordable for SME to offer defined contribution pension plans in line with local labour laws.
Employers can launch a pension plan within hours instead of weeks, with fully digital employee record management, plan administration, investment selection and detailed reporting.
FinFlx is the future of workplace retirement solutions in the Middle East.

fintelite.name: Fintelite
fintelite.description:
Fintelite's AI streamlines loan approvals and fraud detection, ensuring swift, accurate decisions.

Revolutionizing lending with AI-powered bank statement analysis and transaction data enrichment.

Fintelite empowers lenders with a next-generation approach to lending. Our AI platform utilizes:

Bank statement analysis: Gain deep insights into borrower financials through automated analysis.
Transaction data enrichment: Extract valuable details from transactions for a holistic financial picture.
These capabilities enable lenders to:

Reduce fraud: Identify and prevent suspicious activity with superior accuracy.
Accelerate approvals: Make faster, data-driven decisions with enriched information.
Optimize risk management: Tailor risk assessments based on comprehensive borrower data.
Passionate about building a future of responsible AI in financial services. I'm committed to helping lenders serve customers efficiently and securely.


Our help to others includes:
• BlubyBCA and ANZ increased efficiency by 15%
• Qazwa and KoinWorks sped up loan processing 10x, cutting costs by 25%

fire-wallet.name: Fire Wallet
fire-wallet.one_liner: Fire Wallet is a privacy-first crypto wallet designed to just work,…
fire-wallet.description:
🔥FIRE WALLET 🔥

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeXDDegwhgA

TL;DR: Fire Wallet is a fast, end-to-end encrypted, non-custodial stablecoin wallet with built-in payment processing and fiat on/off ramps, built by the team that created MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency inside Signal.

Hey Bookface! We're Josh, Michael, and Manny and we're building Fire Wallet!

🔥Why we built this

Most wallets and payment processors don’t work FOR you. They're slow, route your payments in the way that earns them the most, and they leak your financial life to anyone asking. Worse: every single one hold the keys to your money.

We believe your financial tools should act in your interest and, frankly, that your money should be yours.

 🔥What Fire does

Multi-chain, non-custodial, end-to-end encrypted wallet. 
Your keys, your money, your assets: you are in full control of your funds at all times. 
Least Cost Routing. Every swap and payment takes the cheapest path, not the one that pays a middleman the most.
Self-sovereign payment processing. Send an invoice straight from the wallet. Get paid from your web checkout. No middleman.
Easy fiat on/off ramps. Move stablecoins to USD and back without the pain.
Built for agentic commerce. Manage per-agent sub-wallets for agentic workflows.
Encrypted by default. Protecting you from bad actors and surveillance capitalism.

🔥Early traction

Signed our first major LOI with @Trustboop (founded by Justice Laub of Drone Racing League and Rob Rhinehart of Soylent).

Onboarding our first enterprise customer in ecommerce packaging and marketing, doing about $1.5M/month in volume. They've connected us to 10 more companies in the same vertical at similar volume, roughly a $100M/yr GMV opportunity.

🔥Why us

Josh and Manuel led the creation of MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency in Signal Messenger: $100M+ raised, $1.16B peak valuation, $4B+ peak coin market cap, acquired in 2026. They understand what it takes to build a cryptographic business.

Michael runs product and design. He's an internationally exhibited artist with two published art books, and he builds beautiful products.

Manuel runs operations and orchestrates systems that actually work at scale.

🔥Asks

Intros to businesses moving $1M+/month in payments, especially cross-border, ecommerce, and DTC, who want lower fees and more control over their funds.

Strategic partners in fintech and payments interested in integrating our infrastructure.
Tell us what's broken. Reply here or email founders@fire.co.

We're looking for our first 100 customers. If that's you or someone you know, we'd love to talk.

fithub-2.name: FitHub
fithub-2.one_liner: The one-stop shop for healthy products
fithub-2.description: FitHub is an online supermarket specialized in healthy products, currently operating in Colombia. We have a healthy and eco-friendly sourcing criteria for every product we offer. We are like Good Eggs for LATAM.

flint-2.name: Flint
flint-2.description:
Flint is an AI-powered personalized learning platform for K-12 schools, helping teachers deliver individualized instruction at scale. Trusted by 500,000+ educators and students, Flint has powered learning activities that increase student engagement, academic performance, and collaboration.

Through AI-driven tutoring, real-time feedback, and interactive learning experiences, Flint enables every student to receive personalized support without adding to teacher workload.

With AI-native student analytics, educators gain full visibility into student progress, strengths, and areas for improvement, while saving time on grading, lesson planning, and differentiation. Students receive a 24/7 AI tutor that adapts to their level without giving away answers, supporting deeper understanding and independent thinking.

For schools and districts, Flint provides robust AI guardrails, including customizable moderation, grade-level controls, and full transparency into student usage, ensuring safe and responsible AI adoption.

fluently.name: Fluently
fluently.one_liner: AI language tutor for speaking practice with instant feedback
fluently.description:
Fluently is an AI language tutor for speaking practice. Most language apps teach you to memorize words and pick the right answers in quizzes. But when a real conversation starts, you freeze.

Fluently is built to get you actually speaking. You talk with your personal tutor by voice about any topic or situation you want to practice: a job interview, a difficult conversation or just something fun. The tutor keeps the conversation engaging, adapts to your level and gives instant feedback on grammar, fluency, vocabulary and pronunciation.

Fluently supports 19 languages and costs 20x less than a human tutor.

With Fluently you get:
- Free level test that evaluates your language level with scores across grammar, fluency, vocabulary, pronunciation and coherence.
- Personalized learning plan built around your level and goals, with progress tracking so you see yourself improve.
- Speaking practice on real-life topics: work, travel, job interviews, small talk.
- Pronunciation feedback on every sound to improve your accent.
- More ways to practice: games, courses and vocabulary flashcards.
- 24/7 access to your tutor, with no scheduling.

Available in 19 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Hebrew, Polish, Russian, Dutch, Greek, Turkish, Danish, Finnish and Czech.

Fluently is backed by Y Combinator (W24), Pioneer Fund and angel investors from Dropbox, fal.ai and Higgsfield. The app has 1M+ downloads in 200+ countries, a 4.8 rating on the App Store from 6,000+ ratings and 4.8 on Trustpilot from 2,700+ reviews. Fluently was featured in TechCrunch and was #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt.

Updated: November 16, 2026.

frizzle.name: Frizzle
frizzle.description:
Frizzle uses AI to grade handwritten math assignments for teachers and transform them into rich analytics and differentiated assessment to help personalize instruction for every student. Teachers spend over 10 hours a week or 25% of all their work grading - Frizzle does it in minutes. Frizzle is the most valuable piece of software for teachers ever, as it eliminates the most time-consuming part of their workflow so they can focus on teaching.

Frizzle shifts education from waterfall to agile learning. Instead of waiting for end-of-unit tests to discover gaps, teachers get continuous, real-time insight into student thinking from everyday work. Feedback becomes immediate, instruction adapts weekly, and learning iterates (measure, adjust, improve) so every student progresses faster with less teacher burnout.

Frizzle was named an official White House AI Education Partner alongside OpenAI and Meta: https://www.whitehouse.gov/edai/.

Frizzle was co-founded by Abhay Gupta and Shyam Sai, who met in high school over 10 years ago.

fuse-2.name: Fuse
fuse-2.one_liner: AI-powered workflow automation for US healthcare providers.
fuse-2.description:
AI-powered automation for US healthcare provider workflows like patient intake, eligibility and benefits checks and billing using data-driven approaches. 

If you know senior execs in medical groups or partners in healthcare PE please do connect us. We won’t waste their time: +1 628 468 3232.

givecampus.name: GiveCampus
givecampus.description: GiveCampus is the world's #1 fundraising platform for non-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and more than 1,500 colleges, universities, and K-12 schools, our mission is to advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. Since 2015, we have facilitated more than $7 billion in charitable giving.

govguard.name: GovGuard
govguard.one_liner: Automating Government Workflows, starting with FOIA
govguard.description:
GovGuard is building AI agents that automate government workflows, starting with FOIA requests.

Today, public records teams still spend hours searching for responsive records and applying redactions. Many offices still redact sensitive information line by line with a sharpie. Local governments spend billions processing these requests, and if a city misses a legal deadline, it can be sued for failing to comply with public records law.

govly.name: Govly
govly.one_liner: The #1 Market Network for Government Contractors.
govly.description:
🏛 Govly makes it easier to sell to the government

We...

🗄 Centralize government opportunities
Govly starts out with sam.gov opportunities then allows you to ingest any other contract feed.

You can create targeted searches to find what you're looking and get notified immediately when a new opportunity matches any of your saved searches.

🤝 Facilitate internal and external collaboration
You can easily track what you're working on and see what your team is working on.

You can also partner with other organizations in the Govly network to securely share data back and forth and collaborate on bids.

🤖 Automate repetitive tasks 
You can automate repetitive task related to specific contracting workflows saving users an average of 10 hours per week.

📊 Provide market analytics
You can use our advanced searching alongside our analytics dashboard to identify trends and new business opportunities.

green-canopy-node.name: Green Canopy NODE
green-canopy-node.one_liner: Green Canopy NODE builds sustainable homes fast.
green-canopy-node.description:
Construction costs are climbing out of control, there is a declining construction workforce that gets smaller with every recession. Meanwhile, we’ve got a housing crisis in our major cities. 

Green Canopy NODE is the combination of NODE - construction technology start up that develops a house assembly kits that we manufacture in our factory in Seattle, and then ship flat-pack - like Ikea, and Green Canopy a vertically integrated developer, general contractor and real estate fund manager already operating in Seattle and Portland. 

We are continuing to develop and launch construction technology solutions including prefab components and software into our pipeline of residential projects ranging from small apartments, town houses, single family homes and small dwellings. Our mission is to build homes, relationships, and businesses that help regenerate communities and environments.
green-canopy-node.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

greentoe.name: Greentoe
greentoe.description: Greentoe is a next generation e-commerce marketplace that enables consumers to set the price for the products they want to buy. Created to change the way people shop, Greentoe shakes up the traditional retail model by putting consumers in the driver's seat. They make an offer on a product and the site connects them to the retailers who are willing to accept the offer. The site benefits both consumers and retailers – shoppers can buy products at the lowest price available while retailers reduce inventory and acquire new customers.

guesty.name: Guesty
guesty.one_liner: The management platform for the short term rental industry.
guesty.description: Guesty’s property management software provides property managers and management companies with an end-to-end solution to simplify the complex operational needs of short term rentals. With Guesty, users can manage listings from multiple online travel agencies including Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda and TripAdvisor, and utilize the company’s guest-centric tools including: Unified Inbox, Automation Tools, 24/7 Guest Communication Services, Payment Processing and more.
guesty.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

hadrius.name: Hadrius
hadrius.description:
Hadrius allows regulated financial firms of all sizes to consolidate and automate their compliance processes using AI in one platform. Today, we're securing compliance for $3T+ AUM across our clients.

We're building the AI that will regulate the US financial system and the trillions that flows through it.

halmos-labs.name: Halmos Labs
halmos-labs.one_liner: One API to any physical experiment
halmos-labs.description:
AI can create new drugs and design experiments. They are limited by physical validation. 

physicalvalidation.com by Halmos Labs offers an API to execute any experiment. PhysicalValidation uses compounding knowledge and an experimental design AI to route experiments through contracted labs faster and cheaper. 

Connecting physicalvalidation.com, Codex has designed and tested a new antibiotic without human intervention. It is now possible to close the loop on drug discovery with only a laptop and an idea.

hazel-2.name: Hazel
hazel-2.description: Hazel builds AI-powered procurement software for U.S. state, local, and federal government agencies. We automate the full procurement process including requirements generation, market research, solicitation drafting, and proposal evaluation. Agencies use Hazel to save time and money while improving compliance.

healthkey.name: HealthKey
healthkey.one_liner: AI-powered Patient Identification for Clinical Trials
healthkey.description:
HealthKey helps doctors offices generate more revenue by finding eligible patients for their clinical trials. We match at-risk patients with cutting-edge treatments, ultimately getting patients access to potentially life-changing treatments faster.

Big Pharma pays a lot of money to clinics for each patient they enroll, but finding patients who qualify is an entirely manual process today. We use AI to prescreen doctors’ existing patients against Clinical Trials’ eligibility criteria, making enrollment fast and easy.

helonic.name: Helonic
helonic.description:
We help construction teams eliminate rework, delays, and drawing confusion before construction starts. We analyze PDF plans, detect clashes and inconsistencies across disciplines, and create draft RFIs so teams can resolve issues early.

This saves construction companies hundreds of hours and millions of dollars.

What we do:
- Automatically detect clashes, missing information, and drawing mismatches
- Align architectural, structural, and MEP plans so everything matches across sheets
- Generate draft RFIs from issues we find
- Replace long page-turn meetings with instant drawing analysis
- Reduce rework and prevent schedule delays before boots hit the ground

We integrate with: Procore, Autodesk, email, and the tools teams already use

Teams use us to:
- Save hundreds of thousands to millions of dollars per project
- Catch design and coordination issues early
- Reduce RFIs and prevent field fixes
- Keep projects on schedule with fewer surprises

Contact us at founders@helonic.com

henry-2.name: Henry
henry-2.one_liner: Automating Deal Decks for Commercial Real Estate Brokers
henry-2.description: Henry is an AI copilot for commercial real estate (CRE) brokers that seamlessly integrates a brokerage’s internal data set with external sources to generate custom presentations and financial modeling for deals. Our mission is to help CRE brokers close more deals faster, earning more while doing less repetitive work. We’re initially focusing on enabling brokers to generate deal decks in seconds—a task that typically consumes 20+ hours a week across multiple departments within a brokerage.

hillstar.name: HillStar
hillstar.description: HillStar helps utilities buy power. Electricity demand is surging, and regulated utilities are still mostly responsible for meeting it. Each power solicitation is a multi-decade, billion-dollar decision that takes years, involves 50+ people, and forces hard trade-offs across regulation, permitting, engineering, and economics. HillStar runs that process. In January, we're launching a 2 GW solicitation for a top-five U.S. utility, open to hundreds of power developers.

hypercore.name: Hypercore
hypercore.one_liner: Loan management software for private lenders
hypercore.description:
Hypercore is a loan management software for small lenders. We help lenders automate workflows and provide them with real-time analytics and KPIs on their portfolios.
Since June we are running paid pilots ($3.5K MRR), 1 LOI ($1.5K MRR). The founding team met while serving together as officers in technological units in the Israeli Defence Forces. We then established together a software development company specialized in fintech projects such as e-wallets and open-banking projects. That’s where we discovered how archaic are the tools lenders use that are ready for disruption.
Hypercore is building the tools for private lenders who currently do everything in Excel, culminating in a 'Nasdaq of private loan books' - utilizing the platform to securitize loan books.

impossible-metals.name: Impossible Metals
impossible-metals.one_liner: Underwater robotic vehicles that collect  battery metals responsibly
impossible-metals.description:
Impossible mining is building underwater robotics vehicles which collect battery metals from the seabed without harming the environment. We have $500M+ in off-take LoI’s and have signed a partnership with a global offshore logistics company which holds a seabed mining exploration permit. We have also built the 1st PoC underwater robotic arm.

Polymetallic nodules are rocks which are rich in critical battery metals. Specially nickel, cobalt, manganese and copper. These metals are the the most expensive part of EVs.

inspectify.name: Inspectify
inspectify.description: We founded Inspectify with the goal to make a platform that helps inspectors, real estate professionals and home buyers alike. We see a tremendous opportunity to apply the latest technology to make inspectors more proficient and effective and make home inspections more engaging and value add to home buyers. We are just getting started, but are excited to provide much needed disruption in the space!
inspectify.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

insurf.name: Insurf
insurf.one_liner: The AI-Native Decision Layer for Health Insurance
insurf.description: Insurf is the AI-native data and decision layer for health insurance. Our model Surely identifies the lowest-cost coverage for anyone, saving individuals, families, and companies thousands per employee. Our product Inveto collects the data from hospitals and clinics that informs Surely.

jovian.name: Jovian
jovian.description:
Jovian is an online university for software development and data science. We offer practical and industry-focused programs that help professionals learn technical skills, build real-world projects, and advance their careers.

Students learn practical skills, build real-world portfolio projects, and undergo job readiness training. Our tutors offer 24x7 guidance & mentorship over Slack & Zoom. Students also get access to jobs with 200+ hiring partners.

just-appraised.name: Just Appraised
just-appraised.one_liner: Just Appraised makes software for local governments.
just-appraised.description:
Our goal is to empower local government employees with the tools, technology, and support they need so they can deliver exceptional service to their taxpayers and feel proud of the work they do for their communities. We contribute by building software to streamline local government tax assessors’ workflows using AI. Specifically, we streamline the change of ownership process for real estate and create more seamless ways for tax offices to communicate digitally with their taxpayers.  

For instance, when properties get bought and sold, local governments have to process reams of paper in order to update their systems and perform the analyses necessary to update the tax roll. Our software makes this process 10x faster and much more enjoyable for employees in the tax office to complete, and creates trust and goodwill in the minds of taxpayers.

karmen.name: Karmen
karmen.one_liner: Your AI scheduling assistant for construction
karmen.description: Karmen is an AI scheduling assistant for construction. Karmen builds your baseline schedules from project documents, and updates them as your project evolves, saving you time and potential delays.

klarify.name: Klarify
klarify.description:
Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients.

Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. 

Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it.

Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients.

Nearly 12,300 therapists use Klarify today.

Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.

koala.name: Koala
koala.description:
PROBLEM 😩

Zoom is great for adults, not ideal to engage an 8 year old online.

SOLUTION 🔥

Koala Go, the award-winning interactive platform for online teaching businesses.

Learn more at https://teachwithkoala.com/

kontigo.name: Kontigo
kontigo.description:
We’re building Kontigo, a USDC Smart Neobank for Latinos in the U.S. and Latin America.

We launched our Peer-to-Peer onramp 20 days ago and we’ve already had $540k in deposits, 10k active users and a +300k waitlist. 

The founding team has built and scaled fintechs in Latam, and it’s ex-Venmo, Nubank, Rappi, MercadoLibre, Ualá, Platzi, and Yuno. 

We’re already backed by DST Global, Soma Capital, Pioneer Fund, Transpose + 10 YC alums.

Sending money to Latin America is just as painful as holding it due to the region's fragmentation into 33 countries with 39 different currencies. 

On one hand, cross-border payments to Latam are absurdly expensive (up to 20% per transaction). Conversely, over the past decade, currency depreciation across the region has become unsustainable. (some countries surpassing the trillion percent ). 

Kontigo solves this with a USDC global wallet & a BTC savings account. 

- Like Venmo, but on-USDC.
- Like Zelle, but for cross-border payments. No limits.
- Like Nubank & Revolut, but without inflationary currencies. Bitcoin-backed.

User wallets are connected to an AI-private banker on WhatsApp to execute international USDC transactions.

kuli.name: Kuli
kuli.one_liner: AI coworker for marketing teams at the largest consumer brands
kuli.description:
Kuli is an AI coworker for marketing teams at the world's largest consumer brands. Our agent watches all videos across social media, learns the brand's context and helps them turn signals from billions of social videos into winning campaigns without increasing headcount.

Previous platforms gave marketers databases to search through and a CRM. Kuli actually watches the content. Marketers at team like Disney, Nivea and PostHog use it to scout creators, run analysis on trends and competitor strategies, and analyse what makes their campaign perform better.

For 10 years, influencer marketing meant more tools, more tabs, more spreadsheets. Kuli replaces all of that with one single agent you orchestrate. One marketer with Kuli does what a $50K/month agency bills for manual tasks.

lakonia.name: Lakonia
lakonia.one_liner: Delivering AI-powered situational awareness in tactical environments.
lakonia.description: Lakonia is building an AI-powered command and control platform for law enforcement and the military. Our AI transcribes radio communications, analyzes them, and then synthesizes information for commanders/dispatchers and operators to act on.

lawdingo.name: Lawdingo
lawdingo.one_liner: Lawdingo provides virtual paralegal services to law firms.
lawdingo.description:
Lawdingo gets people in touch with a lawyer very quickly.

Lawdingo gives people seeking legal services direct access to independent lawyers who can help them. Such attorneys usually have more flexible hours, lower rates, and greater interest in customer service than to their larger firm counterparts. The problem is that there is so many such lawyers; how is someone supposed to figure out who is right for them, and who has some time to take on their case? Fair question. Coincidentally, we started Lawdingo to answer just that. 

If you're looking for a lawyer, we encourage you to try finding an easier way to get one to work for you. If you are a lawyer working in solo or small practice, we encourage you to find a more effective way to grow your law practice. 

We also encourage you not to take our word for it. Read what Solo Practice University, the ABA Journal, FindLaw, AboveTheLaw, TechCrunch, Lifehacker, and others say about us. This isn't some fly-by-the-night company. This is the future of the legal industry. We hope you'll get in touch. 

Lawdingo was started by Nikhil Nirmel (nikhil@lawdingo.com), an entrepreneur with a background at Yelp and Wharton Undergrad, and Dan Langevin , a ridiculously talented technologist who was formerly CTO of Lifebooker. Lawdingo has backing from Y Combinator and other investors.

lifeat.name: LifeAt
lifeat.one_liner: One tool to supercharge your productivity.
lifeat.description:
LifeAt is your space to focus and complete tasks. Our mission is to help the 100M+ knowledge workers get into their flow state with video content and task management. Our customers get through their daily tasks twice as fast while feeling great at the end of the day!

Well funded by Meta (Facebook), Line, Y Combinator, Goodwater, and other top VCs. Loved by over 1M+ users across the world and shared by over 500K+ followers across Tiktok/Instagram/Twitter. Come shape the future of focus and productivity!

listia.name: Listia
listia.one_liner: Mobile marketplace for trading used goods.
listia.description: Listia is a new kind of auction marketplace for giving and getting free stuff. Users list items as auctions, and other users bid on these items using credits instead of money. Credits are earned by signing up, giving away stuff, and being an active member.

material-depot.name: Material Depot
material-depot.one_liner: India's Fastest Growing Home Decor destination for Floor & Wall Decor
material-depot.description: Material Depot is reimagining home interiors for the next generation of Indian homeowners. We bring design-forward materials: tiles, laminates, wall panels & more - straight from manufacturers to customers, cutting out the old, broken supply chain. Our online engagement fuels real-time trend insights, enabling us to launch new designs faster, in smaller batches, and at unbeatable prices. The result: beautiful homes built smarter, quicker, and more affordably. With over 10,000 homes served and a rapidly growing digital-first ecosystem, Material Depot isn’t just selling materials—we’re building the future of how India designs and lives.

maxi.name: Maxi
maxi.one_liner: AI Agent for your personal finances
maxi.description: Maxi is an iMessage-based, AI-native agent for your personal finances. It connects to all your accounts (secure read-only access) and Gmail and proactively texts you to help cancel subscriptions, identify split expenses, and send Venmo requests (on your behalf). It also tracks your net worth, reminds you about bills, and keeps you in line with your budgets.

mayflower.name: Mayflower
mayflower.one_liner: AI plug-in that automates HR immigration screening and compliance
mayflower.description: Mayflower is building an AI-powered HR plug-in that automates immigration screening, eligibility checks, and compliance for global candidates. The platform parses documents, classifies visa pathways, and generates attorney-ready forms. By integrating directly with existing HR systems, Mayflower helps companies surface only compliant candidates, reduce legal risk, and streamline the international hiring process.

maywood.name: Maywood
maywood.one_liner: The first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7
maywood.description:
Maywood is the first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7, working across your network, pipeline, and active processes, running constantly in the background and surfacing things you'd otherwise miss. It tracks relationships and sector context to flag when a target is gearing up for a process (and drafts the outreach in your voice), watches network activity across LinkedIn, news, and conference follow-ups, and surfaces where active processes stand, including what's at risk since you last looked.

It also auto-updates CRMs and trackers and creates meeting briefs that includes relationship history, recent activity, deal context, external research, talking points that can pull from internal and external data sources. Dealmakers interact with it over email, Teams, or the platform itself.

mercoa.name: Mercoa
mercoa.one_liner: AI Agent for Billpay platforms to pay invoices with virtual cards
mercoa.description: Mercoa helps AP and Spend management platforms drive more virtual card volume from their BillPay customers. Our agent identifies card-eligible invoices and securely pays them through supplier portals or payment links.

metriport.name: Metriport
metriport.one_liner: Healthcare data infrastructure for next generation care delivery.
metriport.description:
Metriport provides real-time access to medical data for 340 million individuals across the US. Its open-source platform turns scattered patient records across all major healthcare IT systems into structured information that gives clinicians what they need, exactly when they need it, to provide the best possible care. 

Metriport manages dozens of connections across all national HIEs and QHINs, state and regional HIEs, ADT networks, pharmacies, labs, and EHRs. It then matches, extracts, standardizes, deduplicates, and enriches records, and converts them into a unified data model, accessible through a single API, data warehouse, or apps directly within an EHR.

In addition to providing longitudinal patient clinical data at the point of care, Metriport offers ambient monitoring, alerting providers in real time as patients are moved through the healthcare system to assist with transitions of care. Metriport also delivers insights on top of the data, like AI medical record summarization, condition suspecting, and surfacing care gaps.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, Metriport processes 4.2 billion network requests a month and returns the first structured record in under 15 seconds. Teams across care delivery, value-based programs, and health tech platforms build on Metriport, including Amazon One Medical, Strive Health, Color, Sollis Health, and Canvas Medical.

mito-health.name: Mito Health
mito-health.one_liner: At-cost preventive health: Labs, Scans, Genetics, Supplements and Rx
mito-health.description:
Mito Health is a U.S. service that lets individuals order 12,000+ lab tests, scans, supplements, genetics, home kits, and Rx without a traditional doctor’s visit. Members pay $9 per month to access every product at cost and get itemized receipts with no hidden markups.

The average member saves about $300 a year on a full baseline panel.

What the $9/mth Mito membership gets you:

- 11,000+ practitioner-grade supplements at 35% below Amazon (Thorne, Pure Encapsulations, Life Extension, Ritual, Momentous, Seed)
- 1,200+ lab tests from Quest, Labcorp and BioReference at cost · 49 states · HSA/FSA eligible
