- DEXA body composition, bone density, coronary calcium (CAC), whole-body MRI, 30x whole genome sequencing, gut microbiome, multi-cancer early detection
- Every result in one longitudinal record, ordered and reviewed by a partner clinician over concierge
- No markups on tests. No commissions from labs or brands.
- No padded "wellness panels," no upsells, no annual contract; you can cancel anytime.

miyagi-labs.name: Miyagi Labs
miyagi-labs.description:
Miyagi Labs is an AI-powered exam preparation platform built to unlock human intelligence and democratize world-class education globally. We provide students with an elite AI tutor, hyper-personalized study analytics, and an infinite engine of rigorous practice material tailored to exam material.

We currently support major standardized exams across North America, Europe, Africa, and Asia, including the SAT, ACT, and NYC SHSAT (US), the UTME (Nigeria), the KCSE, KJSEA and KPSEA (Kenya), the NEET and CAT (India), and the YKS (Turkey).

We’re building the platform we wish we had when studying for exams. We envision a world where students anywhere can come to Miyagi to receive personalized, world-class AI tutoring designed to unlock their full potential.

momentic.name: Momentic
momentic.one_liner: Mo, the AI QA engineer that bug-bashes your app before every release
momentic.description:
Momentic makes Mo, the AI QA engineer. Point Mo at your app with a goal and a swarm of agents bug-bashes it the way your team would, then reports every bug with repro steps, logs, and a video replay.

Notion, Whatnot, Retool, Webflow, Framer, and 1,600+ teams use Momentic.

Teams also use Momentic to write end-to-end tests in plain English, run them in CI, and let agents triage and maintain the suite across web and mobile.

Learn more at momentic.ai

moonvalley.name: Moonvalley
moonvalley.one_liner: Building the next generation AI creative studio
moonvalley.description: We are building the next generation creative studio, powered by the most capable video and image foundational models. We are creating the place where generative image and video experiences will be built. Backed by Y-Combinator and Khosla Ventures.

moritz.name: Moritz
moritz.one_liner: Global AI-native law firm handling legal work with same-day turnaround
moritz.description:
Moritz is a global AI-native law firm that will handles legal work with same day turnaround.

Our lawyers have closed $ 3bn in deals with an average turnaround of 4-hours. No other law firm offers this kind of speed for complex deals.

We're backed by YC, 20VC and the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, Instacart, Reddit, Superhuman, Producthunt, HuggingFace and 15 other unicorn founders.

moving-atoms.name: Moving Atoms
moving-atoms.description:
Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics. 
It has been action conditioned, so you can simulate robot actions within it.
This lets Robot Labs train their robots using GPUs instead of relying on human collected manual data that is slow and expensive.
In unseen and hard to replicate environments, this is the only path to getting ANY training data.

mudafy.name: Mudafy
mudafy.one_liner: The LatAm tech-enabled real estate broker to buy and sell houses.
mudafy.description: Mudafy is a tech-enabled real estate broker for LatAm that makes it easier for people to buy and sell their homes. Mudafy delivers superior customer experience through technology and data analytics. Their customer-facing product includes 360° virtual tours, online booking for showings & appraisals, and dynamic benchmark pricing data for properties. For agents, they have processes and tools that increase their efficiency by 10x compared to traditional realtors. For the first time, there is a level of professionalism to the LATAM real estate market, which is leading to homes closing faster and at a fraction of the cost.
mudafy.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

nala.name: NALA
nala.one_liner: Building Payments for the Next Billion.
nala.description:
Story here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FZfKgoseJ5E&t=1s

We have two products: 
1. Consumer Cross Border payments to Emerging Markets : nala.com
2. Stablecoin Payment Rails for emerging markets: rafiki.com

nexgent.name: NEXGENT
nexgent.description:
We can provide you with the skills, experience  and knowledge you need to skyrocket through the ranks of the IT industry faster than anyone even if you have zero experience right now.  

Our job-ready training program (which is based on our thorough experience working at Cisco, Dimension Data, Arista, etc. and as IT instructors for the  U.S. Air Force) and and in-person certification will help you master the most in-demand networking skills in 2-5 months so that you can break into a tech job or get promoted. 

Additionally, we provide 1:1 live mentorship from some of the best engineers in the world, skills assessment, career guidance and a proven system that can help you prioritize and execute your career plans confidently.  

Apply to our program here: http://zerotoengineer.com
and/or 
learn more here: http://help.nexgent.com

novatr.name: Novatr
novatr.one_liner: Online cohort based courses for architects, engineers and designers…
novatr.description:
Novatr (YC S21) offers online cohort-based courses for architects, engineers and designers in the AEC industry to advance their professional growth. We serve learners from 45+ countries including India, MENA, USA, Europe, and SEA. Our courses are delivered by professionals from global firms like Autodesk, BIG, Google, UNStudio, AECOM, and graduates are placed at top-tier architecture firms, construction companies and real estate companies.

Project-based learning and peer-to-peer interaction in cohort makes learning enriching and increases the completion rates to 84%. Learners work in groups of 2-6 on live projects and create significant outputs from scratch.

The company is led by alumni of SPA Delhi and IIT Madras.

novig.name: Novig
novig.description:
Novig is building America's #1 sports prediction market. Founded by Jacob Fortinsky and Kelechi Ukah, we are the only platform to offer commission-free sports trading. We deliver better pricing, full transparency, and a more efficient market structure for users by eliminating the traditional sportsbook model.

Backed by the best - Novig has raised over $100M from some of Silicon Valley’s top investors including Pantera, Forerunner, Lux, NFX, Paul Graham, and Joe Montana.

ontra-mobility.name: Ontra Mobility
ontra-mobility.description: Ontra Mobility builds AI software that helps public transit agencies decide what service to run. It generates routes and service options, models travel demand, and helps planners compare tradeoffs across ridership, cost, and rider convenience. Agencies use Ontra to evaluate recurring service changes and major network redesigns, with planners controlling the goals, constraints, and final decisions.

openscale.name: OpenScale
openscale.one_liner: The cheapest, fastest way to run open models and agent sandboxes
openscale.description: Latent Space develops AI applications specifically designed to address the unique challenges and opportunities in emerging economies. Our products are Halo AI (an AI universal concierge for SEA enterprises), GoVisa (an AI-enabled online visa and permit application), and Supa (a hyperlocal knowledge AI for 280M+ Indonesians).

opusense-ai.name: Opusense AI
opusense-ai.description:
Opusense AI automates field report writing for construction field inspectors. Instead of typing up notes at the end of the day, inspectors can now walk a site, speak observations aloud, snap photos, and let our AI assistant generate a detailed, organized report on-site and in real time.

Combined, the founding team has over 15 years in the construction industry. Writing up these field reports used to take up at least 20% of the week. With Opusense, we cut that time by 5x. Our team combines deep construction experience with technical expertise, Roya has a PhD in civil engineering, and Michael has worked at multiple construction tech startups.

Why hasn’t this been done before? Construction is slow to adopt new tech, and reporting is messy, photos, voice notes, and field notes all live in silos. Turning that into a clear, structured report requires real insight into how inspectors work and what clients need. Only now, with advances in AI, can we process unstructured data adequately to generate high-quality reports in real time.

The opportunity is massive. Every inspection firm and contractor is struggling with documentation. Manual reports slow them down, create inconsistencies, and delay handoffs. We believe AI can do this better, and Opusense is proving it.

ora-ai.name: Ora AI
ora-ai.description: Ora is an AI-native precision education platform for healthcare. We increase pass rates, decrease attrition, and identify students who need faculty support. We started with medical school, training students from matriculation to MD. Now, we serve every corner of the $830B healthcare education market: Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, Physician Assistant, Rehabilitation, Allied Health, Dental, Veterinary, Behavioral Health, and more.

orca.name: Orca
orca.one_liner: Banking for Gen Z, on steroids.
orca.description: Orca is banking built for Gen Z from the ground up. Send money instantly, split bills with groups, access local discounts and perks, spend and save, and do everything else you could ever ask on Orca — the only financial hub you'll ever need.

outschool.name: Outschool
outschool.one_liner: A live online learning platform that empowers kids ages 3–18.
outschool.description:
Outschool is an innovative education platform that offers a variety of engaging, small-group classes online. Unlike traditional classes, Outschool classes give kids the unique opportunity to explore their interests in-depth via interactive, live video by experienced, independent educators.

When Outschool was founded in 2015, homeschoolers were the first to discover our classes, but it wasn’t long before kids in conventional schools began supplementing their education with fun and unique, interest-based classes. During the COVID-19 pandemic, Outschool became vital to families who wanted to keep kids learning, social, and pursuing their passions.
Today, Outschool offers more than 140,000 live online classes to more than 1,000,000 learners in 183 countries worldwide.

palla.name: Palla
palla.description: Palla enables instant P2P payments from the US to other countries, a $65BN a year market. Sending and receiving remittances today is slow, time consuming and inconvenient for all parties, as it's a mostly cash based process. With Palla, senders in the US can do it in a few taps of their phone and receivers get their money in seconds.

palomma.name: Palomma
palomma.one_liner: AI & financial services for real estate in LatAm, starting by rent
palomma.description: Palomma is building the AI-native bank for real estate in LatAm. We start with AI agents for property managers (leasing, sales, collections), then add payments to own the flow of rent. This unlocks credit and insurance products to monetize on the $235Bn of rental flows from tenants and landlords.

panadata.name: PANADATA
panadata.one_liner: We run background checks on businesses using data from public records…
panadata.description:
We run background checks on businesses using data from public records in Panama.

Trusted locally by largest banks, law firms, banking regulators, ports, foreign embassies, law enforcement. Our main use cases are due diligence, commercial intelligence and compliance.

parrot.name: Parrot
parrot.description: Parrot is the TikTok for language learning. We turn doomscrolling into fluency with personalized short-form videos. Power users scroll for 6 hours/week on Parrot. Our team of engineers have lived the frustration of ineffective apps and learning methods - we’re building the first language platform that actually works.

parsewise.name: Parsewise
parsewise.one_liner: Multi-document processing for your risk teams, AI agents, pipelines
parsewise.description:
Parsewise provides multi-document processing and analysis that you can embed in your own product.

Operations teams use our platform for oversight and control over their fleet of AI agents, and our MCP to make Claude work at scale with traceability.
Tech teams use our API to replace complex processing pipelines resolving values across documents.

We help customers assess complex risk at scale: manage casualty, specialty, KYC, and financial risks, so teams can act faster and defend their decisions with confidence.

pax-historia.name: Pax Historia
pax-historia.one_liner: The first AI-powered worldbuilding and gameplay platform
pax-historia.description:
Pax Historia is an AI powered sandbox game where players create and upload whatever worlds they can imagine for others to play. What if Rome never fell? What if aliens invaded Earth? What if you were a college dropout creating a tech startup? 

The ability to create, edit, and copy custom maps, actors, historical context, and more means that users can play nearly any scenario they can imagine.

We've organically built a passionate fanbase of tens of thousands of daily active players and we're excited to expand on this early start. Consider joining us to help build vastly better tools for creators and experiences for players.

permitify.name: Permitify
permitify.one_liner: AI co-pilot for building plan review and building code compliance
permitify.description: City building departments are understaffed and overworked. Meanwhile, builders lobby to remove power from building departments. Because building departments are usually the only profitable/self-sustaining branch of a local government, this is problematic. Permitify allows city build-plan reviewers to 10x their productivity covering the labor shortage, reducing the time required to issue a building permit, and allowing the city government's only profitable branch to stay intact.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.one_liner: Canada's digital health clinic for men
phoenix.description: Phoenix is a mission-driven digital healthcare platform for men. We are dedicated to improving the relationship men have with their health, while building the future of patient-centric healthcare in Canada from diagnosing to delivery.

pier.name: Pier
pier.one_liner: Stripe for Credit - Trusted Credit Compliance Partner
pier.description: We’re building an API for launching credit products. We enable companies to compliantly offer credit by handling the tech stack for origination, underwriting and loan management with just a few lines of code. We have built-in compliance guardrails to ensure that our customers comply with state and federal regulations and assist with licensing requirements and license management.

plan0-ai.name: PLAN0 AI
plan0-ai.description:
PLAN0 is building the Bloomberg of construction for real estate developers, investors, and general contractors — $30B of projects are already running through the platform.

We analyze architectural plans using vision models to generate detailed cost estimates and analytics in minutes. Through industry partnerships, the platform also aggregates historical and real-time project data across all major geographies to power ML-driven analytics, decomposing costs into market-observable factors and creating an agentic layer for cost optimization.

poko.name: Poko
poko.description: Poko enables seamless transfers from local payment rails to web3 infrastructure enabling web3 wallets, marketplaces, games and DApps to acquire more users. With Poko’s SDK, web3 builders can easily enable fiat-to-crypto onramping with 100+ common local payment methods or easily pay for NFTs with local payment methods. Poko's fiat-to-cryptoonramp aggregator reduces onramping costs by up to 70% and increases transaction success rates by up to 5x through a smart routing logic and a single integration to multiple onramps. It's Direct Checkout solution enables one step purchasing from fiat payment rails from any smart contract for 79% higher user conversion. The co-founders’ experience includes being chief strategy officer of a $2.4B coincap protocol, leading technical implementation of Singapore’s central bank’s experiment in cross-border payments on blockchain rails, policy experience as payments task force member at the World Economic Forum, ex-Ethereum Foundation Fellow, and CTO of a 2M+ user play to earn game.

postal.name: Postal
postal.one_liner: An AI native virtual address & mailroom for businesses.
postal.description:
Postal offers a modern virtual mailbox for businesses. Postal provides an official address for government, IRS, and vendor communications so companies don't have to use an apartment / shared office address.

Postal's AI summarizes mail and recommends compliance actions, and its marketplace of service providers are ready to perform the mundane compliance work that otherwise falls through the cracks. 

Companies get 6 months free (a $300 value), plus three free hours of compliance services (a $600 value).

prenda.name: Prenda
prenda.description: Prenda makes it easy to open a K-8 microschool in your home, studio or office. We start with an adult guide who cares about kids and believes in the power of learning. Often this is the mom of one of the students. She recruits a class of up to 10 students, and we provide everything she needs to run a microschool - training, support, software, curriculum, and funding so she gets paid. In

probably-genetic.name: Probably Genetic
probably-genetic.one_liner: Patient Intelligence Platform for Genetic Disease
probably-genetic.description: Probably Genetic is changing the lives of patients living with severe, complex diseases. Our data platform is used by drug developers and patient advocacy groups to develop and launch treatments for these patients. Our technology discovers undiagnosed patients online, analyzes their disease state using machine learning and at-home testing, and enables compliant communication with patients. In doing so, we help patients access diagnoses, clinical trials, and treatments as early as possible.

proprise.name: PropRise
proprise.one_liner: The AI platform for CRE investment teams
proprise.description: PropRise is the AI platform for institutional CRE investment teams. We automate the tedious, Excel-heavy workflows that slow down dealmaking: from sourcing to underwriting to due diligence. Our two live products serve 50+ customers including Public Storage: Beacon automates site selection for developers, and Primer extracts financial data from deal packages into structured, model-ready formats, cutting hours of analyst work to minutes. We're expanding across asset classes to become the operating system for CRE dealmaking.

psylaris.name: Psylaris
psylaris.one_liner: Psychotherapy through autonomous and personalized VR-sessions.
psylaris.description:
We empower mental healthcare clients with virtual reality sessions that are additive to traditional therapy. Clients regain their self-reliance the moment they are given the chance to contribute to their treatment. Therapists can focus on the aspects of treatment that e-health is not equiped to deal with. Treatment efficiency goes up - costs go down: 
E-health the way it was meant to be.

raptor-maps.name: Raptor Maps
raptor-maps.one_liner: Raptor Maps builds software to manage the solar PV lifecycle.
raptor-maps.description:
Solar power is the #1 source of new energy in the world. Raptor Maps is a fast-growing, MIT-born startup that builds software to manage the solar lifecycle. We are deployed across 45 countries and 200+ million solar panels. Our software enables the solar industry to scale. 

We're headquartered at Greentown Labs, the largest cleantech incubator in the US and also support fully remote employees.

ravn.name: Ravn
ravn.one_liner: Ravn is building a heads-up display for soldiers.
ravn.description:
Ravn is a DefenseTech company building a heads-up display for soldiers that will allow them to see around corners. In doing so, we allow them to see the enemy and react while they're still behind cover. Our lightweight heads-up display displays videos feeds from a camera on a gun, to drones, robots or other external platforms. Our heads-up display will become a soldier's most relied upon computer.

We currently have four team members, all very experienced in their respective fields. Jake, the Founder, is a former Navy SEAL and understands the market and product. Our Chief Science Officer, Karl Guttag, is an industry leader in the optics and display space. Our VPs of Software and Hardware are both very experienced in their fields. Our primary technology focus is on peer-to-peer applications, near eye optics and displays, cameras/sensors/IoT, and UI/UX (hardware and software).

rdash.name: RDash
rdash.description: RDash is an AI powered construction management software that unifies site teams, procurement, design and finance - out of box; Without requiring customer to stitch anything. We are fastest to deploy and compatible with most accounting and ERP tools.

ready-education.name: Ready Education
ready-education.one_liner: Ready Education is building the mobile OS for higher education. We…
ready-education.description:
Student engagement and persistence pose a significant challenge in higher education. 

Ready Education, the preferred choice of over 350 higher ed institutions, offers custom mobile app solutions that enable colleges and universities to personalize the student experience and support engagement.

Our mission is to make college a successful journey for every student.
 
The Ready Education platform is designed to support student success by unifying campus resources – LMS, co-curricular, athletics, clubs/orgs, events and many more – within a branded, integrated, college app. By adopting the  Ready Education platform, administrators are able to track student engagement, get immediate feedback, and send targeted content to their students.

Clear communication between a student and their institution is crucial when it comes to having a positive higher learning experience. Going mobile bridges this communication gap, connecting hundreds of thousands of students with their administrators, their campus, and most importantly, their peers, both on and off campus. For more information, visit www.oohlalamobile.com.

reconero.name: Reconero
reconero.one_liner: Reconero helps police officers automate their workflows with AI
reconero.description:
Officers join the force to protect their communities, yet over 40% of their day is eaten by paperwork that keeps them behind a desk. The burden reaches beyond lost time. Burnout is driving officers out of the force, leaving those who remain carrying an even heavier workload.

Reconero is built to give that time back. By automating reports, forms, analytics, and more, we help officers finish their administrative paperwork faster, spend more time serving their communities, and protect the time they have with their families.

redcliffe-lifetech.name: Redcliffe Lifetech
redcliffe-lifetech.one_liner: Redcliffe Labs is India's Largest Omni-channel Diagnostics platform
redcliffe-lifetech.description:
Redcliffe Labs (a unit of Redcliffe Lifetech Inc) provides diagnostics with a comprehensive portfolio approach both with routine and specialised test menus with advanced testing labs all over India. Its digital first approach with on-demand 1-hour home collection and same day report is disrupting the way diagnostics is delivered today and thus is the fastest growing in India. 

Redcliffe Labs is providing 3500+ tests across its wide network of labs and collection centres. The company has served about millions of Indians and is processing more than 250K+ test parameters daily. The test portfolio is very wide including routine pathology tests, advanced genetic screening, research-based DNA tests in reproductive health, cancer and wellness/fitness. The easy to interpret smart reports provide key health check-points, which can help in diagnosing and treating both chronic and acute diseases on time. Redcliffe Labs has pioneered Drone technology adoption in the diagnostic sector by opening up the first commercial corridor from Uttarkashi to Dehradun. The company currently has 30+ labs and 700+ authorised collection centres in more than 120 cities across India. 

Redcliffe's vision is to provide world-class diagnostic services to people across the Indian sub-continent in an affordable manner.

rejoy-health.name: Rejoy Health
rejoy-health.one_liner: AI workers that book, scribe, code, interpret, and answer clinicians
rejoy-health.description:
Rejoy Health is the AI care team for clinics. AI workers for healthcare that run the day end to end, from the first call to the last note.

Every missed call is a patient you never see. Every hour after clinic is time you don’t get back. Phones go unanswered, the schedule has holes, and clinicians are still charting, coding, and looking things up while the next patient waits. Rejoy takes that work off the team’s plate.

The AI Receptionist answers around the clock, books and reschedules visits, and never puts a patient on hold, so the calendar stays full. In the room, the AI Scribe turns the conversation into structured notes, the AI Interpreter handles live language in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Korean, and more, and RejoyGPT plus clinical decision support answer questions while the patient is still there. After the visit, the AI Coder suggests ICD-10 and CPT codes so billing goes out cleaner and faster. A medical search engine and study companion sit in the same suite for guidelines, journals, and exam prep.

Not another chatbot. One system for doctors, nurses, MAs, and the front desk. More accurate than ChatGPT. HIPAA-compliant. Trusted by 40,000+ clinicians at leading US hospitals and health systems.

You stay in charge. Rejoy does the work. Book more patients. See more patients. Chart less.

relationship-hero.name: Relationship Hero
relationship-hero.one_liner: Dating & relationship coaching sessions for individuals and couples
relationship-hero.description: Instantly connect with a certified relationship expert to get coaching and actionable advice: how to get a date, how to interpret a text, broken trust after cheating, moving on after a breakup, and more.

remi.name: Remi
remi.one_liner: Simplifying roofing for homeowners, roofers and enterprises.
remi.description:
We find roofers more roofs, and homeowners the right roofer.

There are over 80 million homes in the US, and eventually, every one of them will need a new roof. Our technology  allows contractors to focus on what they do best—getting a repaired roof over homeowners' heads quickly.

rendalomaq.name: RendaloMaq
rendalomaq.description: RendaloMaq is the main tech-powered equipment rental company in Latin America. Leveraging our core tech ROS® (Rendalo Operating System), we simplify and accelerate equipment access for the construction and mining industries. Fleet management and equipment rentals under control. Our mission is to drive productivity through technological innovation while delivering reliable, world-class service.

rimba.name: Rimba
rimba.one_liner: Streamlining Data Capture to Report Creation for Heavy Industries
rimba.description:
Rimba integrates fragmented data — PDFs, Excel files, time-series, IoT sensors, equipment telemetry, and system performance data — to complete a workflow, such as populating a database, running analytics, and creating a report. 

Our software streamlines the entire journey from data capture to report creation for the physical world, starting with heavy industries such as renewables, oil & gas, supply chain, and chemicals. 

Legacy systems don't communicate, and critical operational data remains siloed. Rimba bridges that gap by connecting data from fragmented systems and structures — ERPs, SCADA, SharePoint, email, and more — to automate workflows, classify inputs, transform data, and improve data monitoring.

rippling.name: Rippling
rippling.one_liner: One place to run all your HR, IT, and Finance. Globally.
rippling.description:
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks and Bedrock.

risely-ai.name: Risely AI
risely-ai.one_liner: AI agents that automate administrative work across college campuses.
risely-ai.description:
Risely’s AI agents will form the new operating system for universities, improving retention, staff productivity, and efficiency. Our platform integrates directly into existing university systems (SIS, LMS, CRM), learns each institution’s unique workflows, and deploys specialized AI agents. This dramatically reduces the $735 billion universities spend annually on administrative labor, expands staff capacity without increasing headcount, and improves the student experience.

This hasn't been done before because university workflows require nuanced, autonomous judgment, exactly what agentic AI was designed to solve. Our team uniquely combines deep expertise in higher education, enterprise-scale AI, and regulated enterprise sales.

Sadia previously built Salesforce’s Education Cloud from scratch, creating the core Student Information System widely used across higher education. She deeply understands university operations and maintains trusted relationships with hundreds of higher-ed CIOs and Provosts.

Danial was one of DoorDash’s earliest engineers, where he architected and scaled complex systems from zero to billions of transactions, including their search, recommendation, and Voice AI platforms. He knows how to build robust AI solutions that reliably perform at enterprise scale. 

Shahryar was a GM at Airwallex, where he built the entire Americas business from 0 to 1 and drove 11x revenue growth.  He’s also a master closer, single-handedly securing over $17M in enterprise deals at NerdWallet.  He’s a relentless startup executor with deep expertise launching and scaling go-to-market machines in highly regulated industries.

We launched six weeks ago and are already at $8k MRR, growing 55% week-over-week -- one of the fastest ramps ever in higher ed. Universities urgently need solutions that expand labor capacity and efficiency, especially as they face unprecedented budget pressure and staffing shortages.

With unmatched buyer access, deep technical expertise, and rapid early traction, we are perfectly positioned to own this enormous market.

robocurve.name: Robocurve
robocurve.description:
Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust.

Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits.

Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large performance gaps once deployed in the real world. Building real-world benchmarks means coordinating job-domain experts, evals engineering, and hands-on robotics all at once.

Frontier labs are targeting general-purpose robotics by 2028, yet the field of robotics evals barely exists. Whoever builds the trusted measure of robot capability becomes the reference everyone relies on. We combine backgrounds in AI evals and robotics to build and grow this field as fast as possible. We already shipped v1 of our open-source framework, Inspect Robots, and ran our first pilot scoring a frontier model on a real robot.

rocketlit.name: RocketLit
rocketlit.one_liner: RocketLit is an adaptive learning and assessment platform.
rocketlit.description:
RocketLit gives all students better access to learning and educators access to the data they need to be most impactful.

Our first product, RocketLit, is an adaptive and personalized learning platform that serves reading to students at their independent level. Students read the same content at different levels of complexity and fluidly move up reading levels as they improve.

InnerOrbit is our new Science Assessment platform, giving students, teachers and administrators the practice and data they need to be successful on science tests. We serve the highest quality content and feature the most detailed reporting on the market. 

We’re a small and focused team working to change the world through science education. Our company has served over 650k students and we’re on track to more than double that number in the next year. We’re looking for folks who’ll grow into a leadership role within the organization.

roundabout-technologies.name: Roundabout Technologies
roundabout-technologies.description: Roundabout Technologies makes AI-powered traffic lights, allowing cities to reduce pedestrian deaths, improve traffic, and reduce resident complaints. Our founding team has experience building safety-critical embedded systems and AI at Waymo, Zoox, Google, and Verily.

salem-robotics-inc.name: Salem Robotics Inc
salem-robotics-inc.one_liner: Deploying robots to replace workers in hazardous spaces
salem-robotics-inc.description: Our software turns any robot we deploy into an everyday independent worker at your facility. They are able to walk sites, handle instruments, overcome obstacles, collect measurements, and generate auditable compliance records, replacing hours of mandatory manual surveys and inspections. Built by Los Alamos robotics veterans and deterministic-manipulation researchers, we started in nuclear and are already expanding to other hazardous industries.

serinus-biosciences.name: Serinus Biosciences
serinus-biosciences.description: Serinus Biosciences is tackling one of the toughest problems in cancer treatment: creating combination therapies to override treatment resistance. We leverage cutting edge technology to design a fully explainable AI platform primed with decades of system biology knowledge. Uniquely powered for biological inference, our AI engine uncovers how cancer cells evolve treatment resistance and identifies molecules to overcome resistance escape routes. We design combinations that are safer, more effective, and can get to patients quickly. Founded by MIT PhDs and supported by a scientific advisory board of top academics from the Broad Institute, Dana-Farber, and UCSD, Serinus is powered by Y Combinator and other top investors to revolutionize precision medicine.

shift-health.name: Shift Health
shift-health.one_liner: Turn manual healthcare process into automated workflows
shift-health.description: We help large provider groups and hospitals take their most mundane repetitive tasks and turn them into automated workflows. Freeing up healthcare workers to focus on the important stuff, like patients

shotwellai.name: shotwell.ai
shotwellai.description: Shotwell AI is building the data QA layer for dexterous robotics. We work with teams collecting teleoperation and egocentric data to provide dense semantic annotation and validate task adherence. This lets teams compress feedback loops from weeks to hours and iterate on models much faster.

sift.name: Sift
sift.one_liner: The Leader in Digital Trust & Safety
sift.description: Sift is the leader in Digital Trust & Safety, empowering digital disruptors to Fortune 500 companies to unlock new revenue without risk. Sift dynamically prevents fraud and abuse through industry-leading technology and expertise, an unrivaled global data network of 70 billion events per month, and a commitment to long-term customer partnerships. Global brands such as DoorDash, Twitter, and Wayfair rely on Sift to gain a competitive advantage in their markets.

sigmaos.name: SigmaOS
sigmaos.one_liner: The new home for your internet 🏡
sigmaos.description:
SigmaOS is a new type of browser designed for founders, researchers, and content creators to make you better and faster at working on the web.

You work 7+ hours a day on the web. Buried in a sea of 100+ tabs and 10+ web-apps 🤯, you constantly lose context for why you did what you did, and are always one click away from being distracted.

We took apart the browser for you, and rebuilt a new experience from the ground-up, for the FASTEST and most PRODUCTIVE work. ⚡

snapdocs.name: Snapdocs
snapdocs.description: We're building digital infrastructure and workflow tools to connect the many parties involved in real estate transactions. The result is a more digital, online, and automated process for everyone involved.
snapdocs.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

spark-studio.name: Spark Studio
spark-studio.one_liner: The most magical personal Voice-Led AI English Learning Buddy for Kids
spark-studio.description:
Meet Sparky, a fun and quirky AI buddy in the avatar of a friendly fox who kids can just speak with to build fluency and confidence with English speaking. 
Powered by Generative AI, and made magical with child-appropriate experience, features and topics, Sparky brings a whole world of knowledge and a judgement-free environment for kids to become comfortable with speaking English. 

142 countries (outside English dominant countries) mandate English learning as part of the national education policy. These kids have exposure to English but feel underconfident and embarrassed to speak. The biggest problem across the classes and books they get, is the lack of real conversational practice. With AI, we're making this affordable accessible and enjoyable for kids across the world. 

We're a passionate team of educators with over 30 years of combined experience in building education products for kids and have held leadership positions are India's biggest education companies - Byju's and LEAD.

spruceid.name: SpruceID
spruceid.one_liner: SpruceID lets users control their data across the web.
spruceid.description: SpruceID lets users control their data across the web. Instead of people signing into platforms, we imagine platforms should sign into people’s data vaults. We implement this pattern into digital wallet ecosystems for governments, enterprises, and blockchains. We believe that architectures that enable individual autonomy in the digital world are necessary for free societies and dynamic economies to thrive.

stayqrious.name: StayQrious
stayqrious.one_liner: StayQrious helps kids in India learn through online group classes,…
stayqrious.description: Imagine doing personalised workouts with a fitness coach, but for school subjects. Students log into their session that has been scheduled with their coach, they can see their learning workout for the day. Their workout typically consists of watching an interactive video, writing explanations, giving feedback to other students, making an explainer video etc. They get constant feedback and encouragement from the coach and progress only after they have understood the pre-requisites.

stellar-sleep.name: Stellar Sleep
stellar-sleep.one_liner: We help people with chronic insomnia sleep better, using psychology.
stellar-sleep.description: 25 million Americans with chronic insomnia are getting inadequate and superficial care advice (e.g. cutting coffee, meditation etc.), when in reality, their sleep problems are often driven by deeper psychological challenges like unresolved anxiety. Stellar Sleep uses psychology to help these people break the insomnia cycle.

stralis-aircraft.name: Stralis Aircraft
stralis-aircraft.description: Our planes fly 10 times further than battery electric alternatives, with a lower operating cost than fossil fuel powered aircraft. Our first product is a 15 seat aircraft with a range of 800 km that enters service in 2026 with launch customer Skytrans. Our team has over 85 years of aerospace experience and have developed, flight tested and certified aircraft at Google X, magniX, Heart Aerospace, Ampaire, Airbus, Boeing, Bombardier and Gulfstream. We have $145M in aircraft LOIs from 7 airlines in the US, Europe and Australia.

suiteness.name: Suiteness
suiteness.one_liner: Book guaranteed connecting rooms and suites at hotels
suiteness.description: Suiteness is the first online booking platform with access to an inventory of thousands of exclusive luxury hotel suites. Suiteness is carving a niche for itself in the international travel industry as the leading website dedicated solely to luxury suites and finding success with group travelers and families looking for a nice place to stay together.

sunlight.name: Sunlight
sunlight.one_liner: The intelligence and execution layer for agentic B2B card payments.
sunlight.description:
Sunlight moves B2B payment volume onto card without asking a single supplier to onboard. Our AI agents determine where a bill can be paid by card without a surcharge, then execute that payment through the vendor's own billing or AR portal, returning a confirmed status, receipt, and structured remittance data through a single API.

For decades, moving invoice spend onto card meant building a rail or signing suppliers up one at a time. Both are slow, and both leave most of the volume behind. Sunlight takes a different path. Because our agents pay through the portals suppliers already use, the network reaches every supplier without any of them having to join it.

AP platforms and bank card programs issue their own cards, send them to us, and capture the interchange on volume that would otherwise have defaulted to ACH or check. We are the AI infrastructure layer that makes that volume reachable.

super.name: Super
super.one_liner: Super is the first and leading Indonesian social commerce platform
super.description:
We are building Pinduoduo for Indonesia by enabling community leaders to become retailers within their communities, starting by selling daily products through the Super app. We use technology to: 
1) Help community leaders find the best price 
2) build the lowest cost logistics network 
3) facilitate communication for this social buying behavior

synapse-semiconductor.name: Synapse Semiconductor
synapse-semiconductor.one_liner: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
synapse-semiconductor.description:
We want to push machines to where humans cant go. 
Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.

taanai.name: Taan.ai
taanai.one_liner: the most precise & controllable foundation music models
taanai.description:
Taan builds foundation music models that do what you tell them to, when you tell them to. We're starting with music for video. Give Taan a video and it watches it, then composes an original score that follows the emotion and timing of every cut. If the scene is tense for 10 seconds and then turns happy, the music changes at that exact moment. You get back a fully mixed .mp4. Agents and apps call Taan through our API, so any video tool can add scored, synced music with one call. 

Today's music models can make catchy tracks, but you can't steer them. Ask for "violin at exactly the 11th second" and they usually skip it. We trained Taan from the ground up for control. 

We measured Taan on prompt adherence and instruction success. And against every leading model we tested, Taan was at least 4x better.  

We work with teams building video agents, ad and creative tools, micro-dramas and games. We're musicians and ML researchers. Adithya (CEO) comes from eight generations of Indian classical musicians, tours as a metal guitarist, has done music ML research since 2023, and has filed two patents on music generation architectures. Devansh (CTO) did signal-processing research at IIT Kanpur and was previously an ML engineer at American Express.

tegore.name: Tegore
tegore.description:
Tegore follows K-12 school curriculum to design courses like Algebra I & Algebra II. In addition to working with high schools in the Bay Area to design the best in-classroom experiences, Tegore is developing the corresponding consumer product, a Duolingo for Math.

Each lesson in Tegore follows a lesson plan (e.g. Polynomial Long Division), and the content is delivered with voice / interactive visuals, and checks students' understanding by using dialectic teaching.

tekton-dynamics.name: Tekton Dynamics
tekton-dynamics.one_liner: AI control layer for welding robots
tekton-dynamics.description:
Our mission is to empower every manufacturer, no matter their scale, to invent and build anything using intelligent robots.

Today’s industrial robots are fast but "blind". They struggle with any task that isn't perfectly repetitive. We are building the eyes and brain (a proprietary vision system and AI model) that allow industrial robots to see, reason, and perform complex work with sub-millimeter accuracy and the adaptability of a human expert.

We are witnessing the start of a new industrial revolution: an era of advanced manufacturing powered by AI and robotics. We aim to lead this shift by putting these tools into the hands of every manufacturer, ensuring the power to invent and build at scale isn’t a privilege of the few.

telamont.name: Telamont
telamont.one_liner: AI that catches errors in construction documents
telamont.description:
Construction projects lose money in the gap between what the documents say and what gets built. One missed discrepancy between the specs, drawings, geotechnical study and code can become a seven-figure claim eighteen months later.

Telamont catches contractual, technical and code-compliance risks in construction documents and gives teams the system to act on them before they become costly rework or disputes.

Telamont connects to where your documents live and pulls in every file and revision as it lands, continuously building a complete picture of the project. Every page is checked against the rest of the project, so risks are flagged as soon as they appear. Instead of reviewing documents, teams act on flagged risks, tracking each from detection to resolution while managing exposure and pursuing recovery opportunities across every project.

token-transit.name: Token Transit
token-transit.one_liner: Complete fare payment platform for public transportation
token-transit.description:
Token Transit puts cities in the center of managing new mobility by providing a complete fare payment platform for public transportation.

Token Transit launched our mobile ticketing app in 2016. We now provide payments for transportation in over 200 cities across the United States and Canada with integration into the major third party trip planning apps such as Transit, Moovit and Google Maps.

toku.name: Toku
toku.one_liner: Account Receivables Platform for Latin American Enterprises
toku.description: Toku helps companies increase their monthly revenue collection rate so they can focus on the their main business. Payment method management, failed payment retries, payment reminders, failed payment notifications, among others.

trusty.name: Trusty
trusty.description: Trusty is an agent-to-agent matchmaking network that searches every home, regardless of whether it's on the market. This means fresh inventory for buyers, private offers for homeowners, and happy real estate agents.
trusty.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

union54.name: Union54
union54.one_liner: Developers of ChitChat, an integrated messaging and payments wallet…
union54.description:
ChitChat by Union54 is an integrated messaging and payments platform designed specifically for Africa's unique needs.

Our app combines secure instant messaging with USD card capabilities and cross-border payments, making international money movement more accessible and affordable.

We're tackling one of Africa's biggest financial challenges: the high cost of sending money across borders, where African senders often pay double the fees despite sending smaller amounts.

As a Y Combinator-backed startup, we're building technology that empowers African consumers and businesses to participate more fully in the global digital economy.

Our mission is to create financial products that genuinely serve customer needs while challenging the status quo of traditional remittance providers.

unison.name: UNISON
unison.one_liner: Live between worlds, in UNISON, using the headset we're building!
unison.description:
UNISON is building a unified reality headset to dive in and resurface from virtual worlds with new-found value.

UNISON is a small team of passionate people from companies like Meta, Sony, Apple and research labs like the IARAI, based in the SF Bay Area and backed by some of the world’s best investors. Learn more about us, our product, and team here: in-unison.com.

usul.name: Usul
usul.one_liner: AI Platform for Winning Defense & Government Contracts
usul.description:
Usul helps companies win government contracts in 60+ nations. 

Our AI monitors $8 trillion in annual government spending and instantly matches you to contracts across defense, IT, energy, healthcare and more.

Learn more at https://usul.com/

valink-therapeutics.name: Valink Therapeutics
valink-therapeutics.one_liner: Discovering bispecific antibody drug-conjugates (BsADC) against cancer
valink-therapeutics.description: Valink Therapeutics develops next generation antibody-based therapeutics. We identify novel mechanism of action from known targets by incorporating multiple antibody modifications at once, rapidly and scalable generating complex drug candidates (bi-/multispecificity, multivalency and drug-conjugation in a single discovery process). Our research focus is on solid tumours poorly addressed by immunotherapy.

ventura.name: Ventura
ventura.one_liner: AI Workforce for Distributors and Manufacturers
ventura.description: Ventura builds the AI workforce for distributors and manufacturers, starting with quoting and order entry. It plugs into your existing ERP, follows your SOPs, and learns your team's tribal knowledge - getting smarter with every completed task.

verdant.name: Verdant
verdant.one_liner: AI Agents to Make Local Gov Efficient
verdant.description:
Verdant sells AI agents to local government to make them more efficient. We're starting with permitting, the highest-volume workflow in local government that requires judgment. 

Many startups fail to sell to government, but not us - we've processed 200+ applications and gone from 0 to 4 paid deployments across 4 states with an average close time of 4 weeks.

veriff.name: Veriff
veriff.one_liner: Veriff is a global AI-native identity platform building trust online
veriff.description:
Veriff is a global AI-native identity platform that helps organizations build trust online. Leading companies across financial services, marketplaces, mobility, gig economy, and other digital sectors rely on Veriff's technology to stay compliant, prevent fraud, protect users, and scale globally.

Veriff's trust infrastructure supports the full customer journey, from verification to ongoing authentication and fraud prevention, with the least friction for honest people. With 600+ people in the US, UK, Brazil, Spain, and Estonia, Veriff helps businesses expand across borders without the complexity of managing identity verification, compliance, and fraud in multiple markets – creating a single source of truth for trusted identities. Backed by investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, Veriff is dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer, more secure world.

vestris.name: Vestris
vestris.description: With the government pushing to make title insurance optional on refinances, lenders are starting to take on title risk. Vestris gives every property a risk assessment, like a credit score for homes, so lenders know what they're lending against and homeowners know where their property stands.
vestris.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

voosh.name: Voosh
voosh.description: Voosh is a Food Technology company aiming to empower Food Service brands using our proprietary visualisation tools and Data Science. One stop visualisation tool for CXOs, Operational heads or Zonal managers to get business insights and take real time decisions to help grow online sales.

vorticity.name: Vorticity
vorticity.one_liner: The Fastest Scientific Computing Platform on the Planet
vorticity.description:
Many pressing problems facing humanity can be solved with faster scientific compute. Currently, it takes billions of dollars to design and develop a new fusion reactor, a hyper-sonic airplane or a new cancer treatment. This is because scientists and engineers have to build very expensive things before they even know if their ideas work. But what if we can simulate the workings of these ideas (and more) on computers first and have high confidence that it works before we build really expensive things?

The work of humanity's greatest scientists over the years has given us the physics and math to do this. The problem is that we simply do not have the computing power to solve these big problems.

To address this, the Vorticity Inc is re-imagining scientific computing all the way down to processor architecture and system design. Our proven technology is already helping the energy, life sciences and aerospace industries.

warpfy.name: Warpfy
warpfy.one_liner: Building Shein of Home: tech-driven, design-mfr Home Lifestyle Brand
warpfy.description:
The Fine Living Company (Warpfy) is on a mission to revolutionize the $800B home and kitchen market, building a tech-enabled cross-border Home Lifestyle brand from India—think Shein for Home or Williams Sonoma. 
Our Design-to-Manufacture-to-Consumer model cuts out the middlemen, delivering high-quality products directly to consumers (D2C), through marketplaces, and via our proprietary B2B channel, The India Wholesale Company). 
With a fragmented market where 70% is dominated by single-store boutiques and online penetration is just 20%, Home and Kitchen segment is ripe for disruption. India’s share of products has been minimal due to 60%+ value inflation from intermediaries. We’re changing that.
Our full-stack approach: AI Copilot-driven product design, ERP for multi-channel distribution & manufacturer retention, and optimized supply chain—offers unparalleled speed & value.

wayline.name: Wayline
wayline.one_liner: AI operating system for multifamily leasing, maintenance, and…
wayline.description:
A comprehensive system that sorts, sends, and solves issues so every request and booking gets handled immediately, letting you focus on what drives revenue.

Unify disconnected services and tools with a system that gives you humans where they're crucial and AI for everything else. Get instant, automatic, 24/7 replies for all the routine stuff, follow-ups that follow up on their own, and support from real people when you need it.

waypoint-transit.name: Waypoint Transit
waypoint-transit.one_liner: We automate urban planning so cities can build cheaper and faster.
waypoint-transit.description:
Waypoint Transit is an AI city planner that generates civil infrastructure studies. Cities spend $50B/year on planning. With Waypoint, cities can generate reports in months rather than years, and at 30% of the cost.

Varun and Ryan met at Stanford, where they graduated with degrees in CS and EE respectively. Before founding Waypoint, Varun worked on AI at Microsoft and Ryan worked on chip design at Apple.

US cities are facing three major crises: congestion, budget deficits, and climate change. At the same time, city governments are understaffed and frequently need to contract work out to expensive consultants. Leveraging recent advancements in AI, we empower cities to reduce their costs, build infrastructure, and respond to problems quickly.

In the United States, state and local governments spend $50B/year on planning. Through automation, we can redefine the existing transportation and urban planning consulting markets.

For more information, visit waypointtransit.com or contact us at contact@waypointtransit.com.

webiny.name: Webiny
webiny.one_liner: Open-source framework for building serverless applications
webiny.description:
When the public cloud appeared migration was easy. Existing apps running on physical servers could just be moved to virtual machines running in the cloud. The cloud is now moving towards serverless, and serverless is not backward compatible. New tools need to be created and existing apps need to be rewritten. Webiny provides developers with everything they need to build those serverless apps.

We are a 100% remote team.

wefunder.name: Wefunder
wefunder.one_liner: We're Robinhood for pre-IPO startups. Everyone can invest $100.
wefunder.description:
We help everyone invest in startups that they care about.

We believe that when all Americans can invest in innovation, the world will be a better place. And soon, our dream will become a reality. Thanks to the JOBS Act, everyone — not just the wealthy — can invest as little as $100 in the startups they care about. Not only does this open up the pool of investors, and increase the amount of great ideas that get funded, but it allows startups to grow an army of passionate investors who truly want to see them succeed. Second tier VC’s will become obsolete as startups tap their lead users and customers for quick early investments.

xendit.name: Xendit
xendit.one_liner: Provides payment infrastructure for Southeast Asia
xendit.description:
Xendit provides payment solutions that simplify the payment process for businesses in Southeast Asia, including Indonesia, Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam from SMEs, e-commerce startups to giant corporations. 

Xendit provides a secure, easy-to-integrate payment system, and seamless payment experience supported by great customer service. With a diverse range of products, Xendit’s system can accept payments from virtual accounts, credit and debit cards, eWallets, retail outlets, and also online installments. 

With our aim to build Indonesia and the Philippines’s payment infrastructure, Xendit is on its way shaping the next generation of unicorns by empowering startups to grow exponentially through the products we offer. 

Xendit is licensed and regulated in multiple countries in Southeast Asia

xtraffic.name: XTraffic
xtraffic.one_liner: Technology for cities to automate and manage their traffic lights.
xtraffic.description: XTraffic is at the intersection of advancements in sensor technology and affordability. This means entire cities can affordably upgrade their infrastructure - and some already are. We are live in multiple cities, with both ongoing and successful pilots, corridors of multiple intersections, and soon to be entire cities. Our customers enjoy less traffic, better safety, and data on which to build their future.

you-got-listings-inc.name: You Got Listings
you-got-listings-inc.one_liner: All-in-one apartment Marketing Platform for brokerages and landlords.
you-got-listings-inc.description: You Got Listings is an all-in-one apartment Marketing Platform for brokerages and management companies. Founded in 2009, You Got Listings through innovation and automation has helped push over 3 Million properties in front of prospect renters. We are here to provide the rentals industry with the most comprehensive online marketing solution.
you-got-listings-inc.subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

zenflow.name: Zenflow
zenflow.one_liner: Medical device that provides a more effective, less invasive…
zenflow.description: Forty million men in the US and over 500 million worldwide suffer from urinary obstruction related to benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). The majority of men will experience symptoms of this disease at some point in life. BPH, also known as prostate enlargement, leads to urinary straining, frequency, urgency, and sleep disruption. Despite the high prevalence and significant quality of life burden of BPH, established treatments are limited to drugs, which have limited effectiveness, and surgery, which carries a high risk of sexual side effects. The Zenflow Spring is a small implant delivered in the urologist's office in a simple procedure that provides quick and long-lasting symptom relief.

zenysis.name: Zenysis
zenysis.one_liner: Building powerful data analysis software for developing countries.
zenysis.description: Zenysis builds data integration software that helps governments view and analyze all their data in one place. When governments face pandemic emergencies, humanitarian crises, or natural disasters, they turn to their data for actionable insights. Zenysis puts this information at their fingertips.

business_model.payer: Полицейские ведомства США, покупающие сервис для отчётов.
business_model.pays_for: Автоматическое создание полицейских отчётов из записей нательных камер.
business_model.frequency: Регулярная оплата по подписке или за использование; точные условия в описании не указаны.

violations.reason: Главный клиент — полицейские ведомства, то есть государственные агентства США.

prescreens.speed_reason: Продажа полицейским ведомствам требует долгих закупок и интеграции с системами записи камер.

business_model.payer: Работодатель, который включает продукт в программу льгот для сотрудников, и иногда сами сотрудники.
business_model.pays_for: Доступ сотрудников к части начисленной зарплаты до следующей выплаты и связанные финансовые льготы.
business_model.frequency: Регулярно, по каждой операции досрочной выплаты и по подписке работодателя.

prescreens.speed_reason: Нужна интеграция с payroll работодателей и продажа через B2B-процесс, что занимает от месяца до двух.

business_model.payer: Управляющие компании загородной аренды жилья
business_model.pays_for: Подписку или комиссию за автоматизацию учёта расходов, платежей, карт и согласований для объектов владельцев
business_model.frequency: Регулярно: ежемесячная подписка или комиссия с операций

prescreens.speed_reason: Онлайн-продукт для малого бизнеса с интеграциями в существующие системы, но нужны подключения к ПО и платёжным сервисам.

business_model.payer: Старшеклассники и их семьи платят за AI-репетитора для подготовки к SAT и ACT.
business_model.pays_for: Доступ к онлайн-приложению для подготовки к экзаменам поступления в колледж.
business_model.frequency: Регулярная подписка на обучающий сервис.

prescreens.speed_reason: Онлайн-продукт для семей, но для запуска с нуля нужен качественный AI-тьютор и контент по экзаменам, что требует времени.

business_model.payer: Стоматологические клиники и страховые компании
business_model.pays_for: Автоматизацию диагностики, документооборота и обработки страховых заявок на базе AI
business_model.frequency: Не указано, предположительно регулярная оплата за использование или подписку

prescreens.speed_reason: Для клиник и страховщиков нужны интеграции с их системами и длинный сбор заявок, поэтому первая оплата за три месяца возможна, но не быстро.

business_model.payer: Пациенты или системы здравоохранения (описание не уточняет)
business_model.pays_for: Противораковые вакцины, в перспективе ежегодная вакцинация
business_model.frequency: Не указано; в долгосрочной перспективе ежегодно

violations.reason: Производство и выпуск вакцин требуют клинических испытаний и регуляторных лицензий, что невозможно законно и полностью онлайн без лицензии.

prescreens.speed_reason: Разработка вакцин требует исследований, клинических испытаний и регуляторного одобрения, что за три месяца с командой из двух-трёх человек недостижимо.

business_model.payer: Пищевые и горнодобывающие компании, которым нужно тепло для производства.
business_model.pays_for: Высокотемпературные тепловые насосы, заменяющие газовые паровые котлы; это физическое оборудование.
business_model.frequency: Разовая продажа оборудования, без явной повторяющейся оплаты в описании.

violations.reason: Продаётся физическое оборудование с установкой на объектах клиентов, а не онлайн-продукт.
Описана продажа оборудования один раз, а не подписка или комиссия с регулярных операций.

prescreens.speed_reason: Продажа тяжёлого промышленного оборудования с установкой и инженерной разработкой требует долгих B2B-продаж и научно-технических работ.

business_model.payer: Студенты колледжей, которые проходят годовой онлайн-курс
business_model.pays_for: Обучение в живых группах, оплачиваемое долей зарплаты после получения работы в tech (ISA)
business_model.frequency: Единожды за обучение, после трудоустройства; дальше доля зарплаты, вероятно, выплачивается регулярно

prescreens.speed_reason: Платёж появится только после годичного курса и трудоустройства студента, поэтому первый платёж за три месяца маловероятен, а запуск живых групп требует поиска преподавателей.

business_model.payer: B2B-компании (SaaS и предприятия), которые используют платформу для ценообразования, квот и выставления счетов.
business_model.pays_for: Платформа CPQ и биллинга: расчёт сделок, отправка квот, выставление счетов и сбор платежей.
business_model.frequency: Регулярно, по подписке за платформу; возможна комиссия или плата за использование.

prescreens.speed_reason: Продукт ориентирован на enterprise и растущие стартапы, нужны интеграции с биллингом и месяц-два на продажи.

business_model.payer: Студенты колледжей, которые платят за персонализированную подготовку к экзаменам.
business_model.pays_for: Доступ к AI-сервису персонализированного обучения и подготовки к экзаменам на основе учебных материалов.
business_model.frequency: Регулярная подписка (MRR около $20k указывает на повторяющуюся оплату).

prescreens.speed_reason: Это онлайн SaaS для студентов на готовых AI-сервисах, тестовый запуск с первой оплатой за три месяца реалистичен.

business_model.payer: Крупные модные бренды, покупающие ткань ALT TEX.
business_model.pays_for: Ткань-замену полиэстера для производства одежды, продаваемую как физический товар.
business_model.frequency: Разовые или партийные поставки ткани, не регулярная подписка или комиссия.

violations.reason: Продажа ткани брендам описана как поставки товара, а не повторяющийся доход по подписке или комиссии.

prescreens.speed_reason: Производство биоматериала с ферментацией, физические поставки и продажи крупным брендам требуют долгих R&D и B2B-циклов.

business_model.payer: Конечные пользователи (потребители), которые платят за подписку на AI-поиск без рекламы.
business_model.pays_for: Доступ к ИИ-поиску и ответам без рекламы и слежки; возможно, API для разработчиков.
business_model.frequency: Ежемесячная или годовая подписка (предположительно, по описанию явно не указано).

prescreens.speed_reason: Веб-приложение и API на готовых языковых моделях можно запустить двум людям за несколько недель, но для платной подписки нужна монетизация.

business_model.payer: Розничные инвесторы во Вьетнаме, которые торгуют на платформе.
business_model.pays_for: Доступ к торговле мультиактивами: акциями и сырьевыми товарами через платформу.
business_model.frequency: Неясно из описания: возможна комиссия с регулярных торговых операций, но точной модели не указано.

violations.reason: Платформа предназначена для торговли акциями и сырьевыми товарами, то есть это трейдинг.

prescreens.speed_reason: Нужна лицензия и интеграция с брокерами и биржами, что занимает больше трёх месяцев.

business_model.payer: Исследователи и учёные, которые используют платформу для поиска и анализа научных статей.
business_model.pays_for: Доступ к платформе для поиска, анализа научной литературы и написания обзоров.
business_model.frequency: Вероятно, регулярная подписка, в описании прямо не указано.

prescreens.speed_reason: Это онлайн-продукт для исследователей, который можно собрать из готовых сервисов и API за короткое время.

business_model.payer: Производственные компании и студии, покупающие 3D-принтеры и материалы AON3D.
business_model.pays_for: Промышленные 3D-принтеры и термопластичные материалы для печати.
business_model.frequency: Разовая покупка оборудования, материалы могут закупаться регулярно.

violations.reason: Основной продукт — оборудование, которое продаётся разово.
Продажа физического оборудования и материалов, а не трейдинг или госсервис; но продукт — физические товары, что нарушает общий профиль бизнеса.

prescreens.speed_reason: Продажа физического промышленного оборудования требует производства, логистики и сервиса на месте, что долго и дорого для двух-трёх человек.

business_model.payer: Frontier AI labs и компании медицинского ИИ, а в будущем больницы и health-системы.
business_model.pays_for: Инфраструктуру для дообучения и оценки медицинских ИИ-моделей: RL-среды на деидентифицированных EHR, данные, проверенные врачами, и бенчмарки.
business_model.frequency: Неясно из описания: возможны проекты и лицензии, регулярность не указана.

prescreens.speed_reason: Продажа лабораторий и health-систем требует длинного сотрудничества, а работа с EHR-данными и врачебной разметкой требует интеграций и времени.

business_model.payer: Софтверные компании, продающие госзаказчикам, платят Archon за ускорение сертификации FedRAMP.
business_model.pays_for: Сокращение сроков и затрат на федеральную compliance-сертификацию FedRAMP для выхода на госрынок.
business_model.frequency: Не указано; вероятно разовый проект, а не регулярные платежи.

violations.reason: Описание указывает на разовое сокращение сроков сертификации, а не на подписку или регулярные операции.
Бизнес ориентирован на продажи госзаказчикам через федеральную сертификацию FedRAMP.

prescreens.speed_reason: Услуга консалтинга по сертификации требует сопровождения клиентов и продаж B2B, что занимает месяцы.

business_model.payer: Школы и учителя, покупающие доступ к голосовому ассистенту для класса.
business_model.pays_for: Подписку на аудио-ассистента для управления классом и поддержки уроков через умные колонки.
business_model.frequency: Регулярная подписка, предположительно ежемесячно или ежегодно.

prescreens.speed_reason: Нужны интеграции с умными колонками и продажи школам, что занимает месяц-два.

business_model.payer: Совет домовладельцев (HOA) и сами собственники жилья в управляемых сообществах.
business_model.pays_for: Управление ассоциацией: операционные задачи, автоматизация рутины, ПО и профессиональная поддержка советов в Bay Area и Greater Los Angeles.
business_model.frequency: Регулярная плата за управление, вероятно ежемесячно или ежегодно по договору.

prescreens.speed_reason: Продажа управленческих услуг HOA требует переговоров с советами и вовлечения в операции, поэтому запуск займёт время.

business_model.payer: Операторы дата-центров для ИИ, которым нужна подготовленная под мощность земля.
business_model.pays_for: Поиск и подготовку участков с доступной энергомощностью под строительство дата-центров.
business_model.frequency: Разовая сделка или оплата по проекту, а не регулярные платежи.

violations.reason: Описана разовая оплата за найденные участки, а не подписка или регулярная комиссия.

prescreens.speed_reason: Продажа дата-центрам требует длинного корпоративного цикла, земельных и энергетических исследований, поэтому первый платёж за три месяца маловероятен.

business_model.payer: Производственные компании, которым нужны пластиковые детали.
business_model.pays_for: Изготовление пресс-форм и пластиковых деталей по их геометрии.
business_model.frequency: Разовые заказы на детали и формы, без явной повторяемости подписки.

violations.reason: Описание указывает на физическое производство пластиковых деталей и пресс-форм, а не на полностью онлайн-продукт.
Продажа деталей и пресс-форм под уникальные геометрии выглядит как разовые заказы, а не регулярные платежи.

prescreens.speed_reason: Нужны собственное производство, пресс-формы и инженерные работы, что не запускается командой из двух-трёх человек за три месяца.

business_model.payer: Читатели, которые слушают истории и хотят аудиокниги с разными голосами персонажей.
business_model.pays_for: Создание аудиокниги из текста или ссылки с озвучкой персонажей генеративным ИИ.
business_model.frequency: Не указано, похоже на разовую покупку или генерацию аудиокниги за раз.

prescreens.speed_reason: Онлайн-продукт для потребителей на готовых ИИ-сервисах для синтеза голоса, запуск тестов возможен быстро.

business_model.payer: Инженеры и стартапы, заказывающие малые партии печатных плат.
business_model.pays_for: Сборку печатных плат под малые тиражи (до 10 штук) с закупкой компонентов и доставкой.
business_model.frequency: Разовые заказы, а не регулярная подписка или комиссия.

violations.reason: Бизнес физический: сборка плат выполняется вручную в мастерской в Сан-Франциско.
Описание указывает на разовые заказы плат под конкретные задачи, а не на регулярные платежи.

prescreens.speed_reason: Требует физического производства и сборки плат в собственной мастерской, поэтому запуск теста силами двух-трёх человек без производственной базы нереалистичен.

business_model.payer: Ресторан или розничный покупатель, платящий за свежую зелень, выращенную Beanstalk.
business_model.pays_for: Свежие овощи и зелень (салат, шпинат, базилик и др.), выращенные на вертикальной ферме.
business_model.frequency: Неясно из описания; вероятно, регулярные поставки.

violations.reason: Бизнес связан с выращиванием и поставкой физической продукции, а не онлайн-сервисом.

prescreens.speed_reason: Нужна собственная вертикальная ферма с робототехникой и производство физического продукта, что требует больших инвестиций и времени.

business_model.payer: Органы государственного здравоохранения и муниципалитеты, покупающие аналитику по сточным водам.
business_model.pays_for: Аналитика биомаркеров в сточных водах для оценки состояния здоровья населения городов.
business_model.frequency: Неясно из описания, вероятно периодические контракты на мониторинг.

violations.reason: Основной заказчик — государственные органы и публичное здравоохранение, индустрия указана как Government.

prescreens.speed_reason: Требует лабораторного оборудования, отбора проб в канализации и длительных продаж государственным структурам.

business_model.payer: Выпускники курсов, которые после трудоустройства получают доход выше порога.
business_model.pays_for: Доля дохода после трудоустройства (income share agreement) за обучение, которое было бесплатным.
business_model.frequency: Регулярные выплаты из дохода в течение определённого периода после найма, пока доход выше порога.

violations.reason: Компания сама финансирует обучение бесплатно и берёт на себя риск того, что студент не найдёт работу, то есть несёт кредитный риск по собственным инвестициям в студентов.

prescreens.speed_reason: Онлайн-курсы и соглашения об income share можно запустить быстро, но нужны юридические документы и процесс оценки доходов.

business_model.payer: Школы (K-12) оплачивают доступ к системе для учеников.
business_model.pays_for: Доступ к AI-платформе с учебной программой, AI-обучением и оценкой знаний.
business_model.frequency: Вероятно, регулярная подписка на учебный год; в описании прямо не указано.

prescreens.speed_reason: Продажа школам требует пилотов и согласования с администрацией, что занимает месяц или два; продукт в целом онлайн.

business_model.payer: Физические лица, которым нужна юридическая помощь, и, возможно, бизнес-клиенты в B2B-сегменте.
business_model.pays_for: Юридические консультации через веб-приложение и представительство адвокатами по делам до их завершения.
business_model.frequency: Неясно: из описания не следует, есть ли регулярная подписка или разовая оплата по каждому делу.

violations.reason: Компания оказывает юридическую помощь через адвокатов и судебное представительство, что требует лицензии адвоката и не сводится к полностью онлайн-продукту.

prescreens.speed_reason: Веб-приложение для консультаций быстро запустить, но представительство требует адвокатов, лицензий и продаж дел, что занимает больше трёх месяцев.

business_model.payer: Больницы, страховщики и медицинские программы, которые платят за удалённый мониторинг пациентов с сердечной недостаточностью.
business_model.pays_for: Аппаратные весы с алгоритмами предиктивной аналитики и программное обеспечение для команд ухода.
business_model.frequency: Регулярно, в виде подписки или платы за мониторинг пациентов, но точная модель не описана.

prescreens.speed_reason: Нужны аппаратные весы с медицинской сертификацией и интеграции с больницами, что занимает время и требует продаж в здравоохранении.

business_model.payer: Застройщики и строительные компании, покупающие роботизированные системы для строительства жилья.
business_model.pays_for: Роботизированные системы и программное обеспечение для строительства домов, включая аппаратное обеспечение.
business_model.frequency: Разовые покупки или проекты по строительству; регулярность из описания не следует.
